title: Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI: Cogentiq
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

### **Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced **Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI** to design, build and productionize enterprise-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs and modern AI architecture.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking AI solutions from **experimentation to production**, working across models, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Architect, build and productionize **AI/ML and Generative AI solutions** for complex enterprise use cases.
* Design and develop **LLM-powered applications** using RAG, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Build scalable AI services and backend applications using **Python, REST APIs and modern microservices architectures**.
* Design end-to-end **RAG architectures** incorporating embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Develop AI applications using frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex or equivalent**.
* Work with leading LLM platforms such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent**.
* Design and implement practices around **LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, security, latency and cost optimization**.
* Build robust AI/ML pipelines covering experimentation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Integrate AI solutions with **enterprise applications, APIs, databases, data platforms and cloud services**.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks and technologies and translate them into practical enterprise solutions.
* Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across AI platforms and products.
* Establish engineering best practices for building secure, scalable and maintainable AI applications.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI engineering initiatives.
* Partner with product managers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to convert business problems into scalable AI solutions.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **10+ years of overall experience** in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology roles.
* Strong hands-on development experience in **Python**, with excellent software engineering and system-design fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of **Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models**.
* Demonstrated experience **building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications into production**.
* Hands-on experience with **RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration and AI agents**.
* Experience designing **agentic AI workflows**, including tool/function calling and complex or multi-agent orchestration.
* Experience working with at least one major LLM ecosystem such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent**.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases and enterprise application architecture**.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: **AWS, Azure or GCP**.
* Experience with **LLM evaluation, monitoring, observability, responsible AI and guardrails**.
* Ability to independently own the technical architecture and implementation of complex AI solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering/architecture decisions.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with **knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers or GraphRAG**.
* Experience with **MLOps/LLMOps**, model serving, CI/CD and AI observability platforms.
* Experience with vector databases such as **Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Redis or equivalent**.
* Experience with **fine-tuning, model adaptation and open-source LLMs**.
* Experience with AI security, governance, privacy and enterprise AI architecture.
* Hands-on exposure to **PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel** or similar frameworks.
* Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring senior engineers.
* Understanding of **data engineering, streaming, distributed data processing and modern cloud data platforms**.

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related** **quantitative/technical** **discipline**.
* Strong academic background, preferably from a **premier** **engineering/technology** **institution** with a demonstrated record of academic and technical excellence.

### **What Will Make You Stand Out**

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate that they have **personally architected and built production GenAI systems**, rather than simply experimented with LLMs.

Strong candidates will be able to discuss real-world experience around:

* Production **RAG and Agentic AI architectures**
* Building scalable **Python/API-based AI services**
* LLM evaluation and observability
* Enterprise data and application integration
* Security and guardrails
* Latency and inference-cost optimization
* Taking an AI solution from **prototype production scale**

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
description:
**About** **JazzX AI****:**

***Vision:*** *Enterprises operating on institutional intelligence—governed, self-improving, and scalable beyond individual expertise.*

JazzX AI is defining the future of enterprise work—by building AI-native digital workers that actually get the job done.

We believe enterprises don't scale expertise—they lose it. Knowledge stays trapped in individuals, judgment gets applied inconsistently, and the best talent spends time on work that should run itself. We're changing that.

JazzX AI transforms messy enterprise reality into institutional intelligence: governed digital workers that capture expert judgment, make every decision explainable, and continuously improve through real-world execution. The result is faster decisions, higher-quality outcomes, and reliable execution at scale—in domains where getting it wrong isn't an option.

We're starting with lending and due-diligence workflows—complex, regulated, high-stakes. From here, we're building the backbone for enterprise intelligence across industries.

This is early-stage, hard, and consequential work. If you want to be part of bringing AI systems to market that actually run in production, handle real complexity, and deliver real outcomes—not demos, not chatbots—JazzX AI is the place.

**About** **SAIGroup** **:**

SAIGroup a private investment firm that has committed $1B to build and scale next-generation, AI-powered enterprise software companies. SAIGroup's portfolio serves 2,000+ global enterprise customers, generates nearly $800M in annual revenue, and employs 4,000+ people worldwide — providing JazzX AI with long-term capital, deep operating expertise, and access to real-world enterprise scale from day one.

  

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning (RL) to join our team as a Senior Staff Architect. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping the vision, architecture, and technical execution of RL-driven AI reasoning models and systems that power next-generation enterprise AGI platform.

You will lead the design, development, and optimization of cutting-edge RL solutions, from experimentation and simulation through production deployment. This includes building scalable training architectures, architecting multi-agent and hierarchical RL frameworks, and ensuring that the RL systems are resilient, efficient, explainable and safe.

As a senior technical leader, you will partner with cross-functional teams—including product, core platform engineering, and research—to define architectural best practices, establish governance standards, and enable seamless integration of RL into our broader AGI platform. You will also drive innovation by exploring novel RL techniques, mentoring engineers and researchers, and ensuring the RL infrastructure can scale to support high-throughput training and real-world scenarios and enterprise use cases end to end.

Ultimately, your work will be critical in bridging research and production, ensuring that the latest RL advancements translate into reliable, impactful, and enterprise-ready AI solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Design:** Define and drive the end-to-end architecture for reinforcement learning–based systems, including training pipelines, simulation environments, reward shaping, and model serving.
* **Research & Development:** Apply cutting-edge RL techniques (policy optimization, model-based RL, hierarchical RL, multi-agent RL, etc) to solve complex enterprise problems.
* **Scalability & Infrastructure:** Design distributed training systems, leverage cloud-native infrastructure, and optimize for performance, reproducibility, and cost-efficiency.
* **Leadership & Mentorship:** Provide technical leadership to AI engineers and researchers; mentor junior team members; review designs and code with a focus on scalability, robustness, and clarity.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with product, data, and platform teams to align RL solutions with strategic business goals and integrate them into production systems.
* **Evaluation & Monitoring:** Define frameworks for benchmarking, continuous evaluation, and feedback-driven improvements in deployed RL models.
* **Compliance & Safety:** Ensure RL systems align with ethical AI practices, safety constraints, and regulatory standards for enterprises.

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years of experience** in AI/ML engineering, including at least **5 years specializing in reinforcement learning research and production systems**.
* Demonstrated success in **designing and deploying large-scale RL architectures** in enterprise environments.
* Deep expertise in **reinforcement learning algorithms**, including on-policy (PPO, A3C) and off-policy (SAC, DDPG) methods, along with hands-on work in **simulation frameworks** (e.g., OpenAI Gym, Isaac Gym, PettingZoo, MuJoCo).
* Practical experience with **multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)**, including coordination strategies for complex environments.
* Strong proficiency in **Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)** and **GRPO-like policy optimization approaches**, applying reinforcement learning principles both rigorously and pragmatically.
* **Experience with test-time compute optimization techniques**, including inference-time search, chain-of-thought reasoning, and adaptive computation strategies for improving model performance during deployment.
* Proven ability in **large language model (LLM) training and fine-tuning**, across both supervised and reinforcement learning–driven techniques.
* Advanced software engineering skills in **Python, C++, or Java**, with deep expertise in ML frameworks such as **TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, or Ray RLlib**.
* Hands-on experience with **distributed training infrastructure** (Kubernetes, GPU/TPU clusters, and cloud ML platforms).
* Excellent **communication, collaboration, and leadership skills**, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or related field.
* Experience leading enterprise AI adoption and guiding organizational strategy for RL powered systems.
* Contributions to open-source RL frameworks or publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, AISTATS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI).
* Background in safety, alignment, or explainability of RL agents.

  

We offer a competitive salary ranging from **USD 207,000 to USD 290,000**, along with equity options and an attractive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, flexible working arrangements, and more.

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Why Join JazzX AI:**

What draws people to JazzX AI is the opportunity to build something truly foundational.

**We are at the beginning of a new era** — one where enterprise systems will no longer be static tools, but **dynamic collaborators** that learn, reason, and evolve alongside the people who use them. At JazzX AI, you'll help build a platform that redefines how work happens in the **AGI era**.

JazzX AI brings together **vision, deep technology, and purpose**. This is not about experimenting with AI features; it's about turning the promise of **AGI** into **practical, auditable, and human-aligned systems** that enterprises can trust and rely on at scale. The work here directly impacts productivity, efficiency, and decision-making in complex, real-world environments.

If you're motivated by building systems that matter — systems that combine intelligence with responsibility — JazzX AI offers the chance to do that work at a deeper level, with real ownership and lasting impact.

**Headquartered in Los Altos, CA. Backed by SAIGroup.**

**Learn more about JazzX AI:**

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jazzx-ai

title: Senior Engineer - Cloud Security
description:
Company Summary:

DISH Network Technologies India Pvt. Ltd is a technology subsidiary of EchoStar. Our organization is at the forefront of technology, serving as a disruptive force and driving innovation and value on behalf of our customers.

Our product portfolio includes Boost Mobile (consumer wireless), DISH TV (direct broadcast satellite), Sling TV (over-the-top service provider), Hughes (global satellite connectivity solutions) and Hughesnet (satellite internet).

Our facilities in India are some of EchoStar's largest development centers outside the U.S. As a hub for technological convergence, our engineering talent is a catalyst for innovation in multimedia network and communications development.

EchoStar does not charge any fees to job applicants or candidates at any point during the recruitment and hiring process. We strongly advise all individuals to be vigilant and disregard any unsolicited requests for payment or personal financial information related to an EchoStar employment opportunity.

Summary:

Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our people play vital roles in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled **AWS Senior Security Engineer** to join our cloud security team. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain robust security controls across our Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure. You will focus on Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), identity and access management, AI-driven automation and security implementation, and broad-spectrum architectural security across all core AWS services—ensuring our cloud workloads remain resilient against emerging threats while enabling rapid business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Implement and manage CSPM tools (e.g., Cortex XSIAM, AWS Security Hub, etc) to maintain real-time visibility into misconfigurations, compliance posture, and risk posture across multi-account environments.
* Establish baseline security practices across the breadth of AWS services (Compute, Storage, Database, Serverless, Networking, Messaging, and Governance) to guarantee defense-in-depth across the entire AWS ecosystem.
* Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize AI/ML capabilities (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Amazon Q, SageMaker, LLM security practices) to automate security workflows, incident response playbooks, and threat intelligence while securing AI pipelines and workloads.
* Architect, enforce, and audit fine-grained IAM policies, Service Control Policies (SCPs), role hierarchies, and temporary credentials adhering strictly to the principle of least privilege and CIEM principles.
* Configure and manage encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS, Secrets Manager, and Certificate Manager. Maintain secure VPC network architectures, security groups, Network ACLs, and AWS WAF configurations.
* Monitor security logs via CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config. Build automated incident response playbooks using EventBridge, Lambda, and SOAR tools to contain security incidents instantly.
* Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines. Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Ensure multi-account cloud operations meet industry security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) using AWS Control Tower and AWS Config rules.

Skills - Experience and Requirements:

* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise CSPM platforms (Prisma Cloud, Wiz, AWS Security Hub, AWS Config) for continuous risk assessment, misconfiguration detection, and compliance tracking.
* In-depth architectural security understanding of core and advanced AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, SNS/SQS, KMS, and IAM.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals and practical experience applying generative AI/LLM models or AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q) to automate security analysis, triage, and security operations.
* Deep mastery of AWS IAM, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, SCPs, and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) principles.
* Strong knowledge of VPC design, Subnets, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS WAF, and Shield.
* Proficiency with Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, or Boto3 for automating security controls and remediation workflows.

### **Professional Experience & Soft Skills**

* Must have 5+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security or cybersecurity engineering, with at least 3+ years explicitly focused on AWS, GCP environments.
* Proven ability to communicate security risks effectively and partner with developer teams to resolve issues without creating operational friction.
* Demonstrated track record of conducting post-incident root-cause analysis and driving continuous improvement.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* AWS Certified Security - Specialty
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* ISC2 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA) / CISSP

title: Architect
description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

Platform Architect, Developer Productivity

**The role**
------------

You will set the multi-year architecture for Myntra’s developer platform: the CI/CD, environments, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows that every engineering team builds on. You will be the final authority on trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The goal is to make shipping fast, safe, and cheap for engineers across Myntra, and to measure it by outcomes rather than activity. You will own the platform blueprint across multiple product areas, not just one, and will weigh emerging technology trends against long-term business goals.

  
  

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Define the architecture and roadmap for a unified internal developer platform, with paved paths for build, test, deploy, observe, and operate. The platform should support 10x scale.
* Own the architecture blueprint across product areas. Unify duplicated patterns, tooling, and service hops into shared platforms, and remove silos between teams.
* Turn vague developer pain points, such as slow pipelines, environment sprawl, and on-call toil, into clear problems and technical directions, and drive them to shipped systems.
* Decide which problems matter at division scale and which to ignore, and drive major technology decisions to closure across product areas.
* Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering across the division: agent workflows, secure prompting, AI code review and verification, and token/compute governance.
* Define AI-native engineering paradigms for the division, including how autonomous agents are used, supervised, and kept within safe boundaries.
* Make build vs. buy vs. offload calls on tooling (including AI tools) using cost data. Replace expensive vendor tools with leaner internal or open-source ones where the numbers support it.
* Establish observability, SLO, and chaos-engineering standards that reduce org-wide MTTR. Design for graceful degradation and BCP.
* Design platforms that are self-healing and debuggable by design, remove single points of failure, and isolate heavy AI/compute workloads from core traffic.
* Own FinOps and security guardrails for platform services, including zero-trust, data privacy, and responsible-AI boundaries.
* Set division-wide compliance, security, and cost-governance standards, and balance large multi-cloud infrastructure investments against their return.
* Measure developer productivity with SPACE and DORA, not PR or line counts. Cover satisfaction, flow, and cognitive load as well as delivery speed.
* Act as the DRI across teams. Resolve cross-functional impasses by speaking both technical and business language, and advise VPs and managers.
* Represent the platform in executive and external technical forums.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.
* Mentor and sponsor other architects, and build mentorship frameworks that scale beyond your direct network.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Deep experience architecting large-scale platforms, such as cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and internal developer platforms.
* Strong grounding in distributed systems design, SRE practice (SLIs/SLOs, incident response, RCA discipline), and Kubernetes, IaC, and multi-region/hybrid-cloud resilience.
* Hands-on fluency with AI IDEs and agents, plus judgment on verifying AI output, building evals, and modelling inference cost.
* Track record of adoption: platforms and standards that teams outside your own use, not slide-deck architecture.
* Cost and risk judgment, including cloud/GPU capacity planning and data-privacy compliance.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to make the final call when a group is stuck and keep trust.
* Experience owning architecture across multiple product areas or a whole division, including multi-million-dollar infrastructure decisions.
* A record of developing other architects and tech leads.

title: Systems/Software Engr
description:

title: Engineering Director
description:
Engineering Director – Data & AI

WHO WE ARE

At Maersk, we are on a transformative journey to become the Global Integrator of container logistics, connecting and simplifying our customers' supply chains through technology, data, and innovation. Our SAP landscape is a critical backbone of this vision, and we are accelerating a shift towards modern, scalable, and cost-efficient in-house engineering capabilities.

The Position

As Engineering Director for Data & AI, you will lead a high-impact organization responsible for modernizing enterprise data engineering, analytics, reporting, and AI-enabled product capabilities. You will keep the current priorities on track while accelerating the shift from fragmented, tool-heavy, and centrally dependent models to scalable, governed, self-service capabilities that reduce overhead and improve business outcomes.

You will own the strategy, architecture alignment, and execution of modern data foundations, self-service data query and reporting experiences, and AI-based engineering practices. The role requires deep collaboration across product, platform, SAP, enterprise architecture, security, data governance, and business teams—often beyond direct reporting lines—to influence outcomes at scale.

You will play a critical leadership role in reducing dependency on costly enterprise software, enabling engineering-led innovation, and building outcome-based data and AI products that improve decision quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and user productivity.

  

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering Modernization

* Define and lead the modernization of data engineering capabilities across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, quality, lineage, and consumption layers.

* Reduce operational overhead through automation, reusable data patterns, shared engineering standards, and simplified platform architecture.

* Drive the transition from project-by-project data delivery to scalable, product-oriented data foundations that support analytics, reporting, AI, and decision intelligence use cases.

* Establish clear engineering practices for data reliability, observability, performance, supportability, and operational resilience across critical data pipelines and products.

Self-Service Data & Reporting Enablement

* Create governed, queryable data layers that enable business and product teams to access trusted data without dependency on costly enterprise software or central reporting bottlenecks.

* Enable intuitive self-service data discovery, query, reporting, and reuse through standard semantic layers, reusable metrics, data contracts, metadata, and access governance.

* Modernize reporting capabilities to deliver scalable, self-service dashboards and insights with lower total cost of ownership.

* Rationalize reporting tools, dashboards, and data marts by promoting shared metrics, standard data products, reusable templates, and fit-for-purpose lower-cost technology choices where appropriate.

* Ensure reporting outputs are reliable, timely, consistent, secure, and aligned to business-critical decision-making needs.

AI-Based Engineering & Data Product Outcomes

* Drive a strong focus on AI-based engineering, including AI-assisted development, intelligent data quality, automated insight generation, knowledge retrieval, and agentic workflows where they create measurable value.

* Build impactful data and AI products that solve priority business problems and are measured through adoption, operational improvement, cost reduction, better decisions, or productivity gains.

* Ensure data products are designed for reuse, discoverability, interoperability, and integration with AI platforms, copilots, agents, and decision intelligence solutions.

* Establish an outcome discipline where data, analytics, reporting, and AI investments are linked to clear value cases, usage measures, and business benefit realization.

* Promote responsible, secure, and governed AI adoption across engineering teams, ensuring AI solutions are reliable, explainable where needed, and aligned to enterprise controls.

Keeping Existing Priorities on Track

* Maintain delivery discipline across current data engineering, analytics, reporting, and platform commitments while introducing modernization in a controlled, outcome-focused way.

* Protect continuity of in-flight priorities by ensuring clear ownership, transparent sequencing, strong stakeholder communication, and measurable delivery milestones.

* Balance modernization, cost optimization, AI adoption, and business-as-usual reliability so existing business-critical reporting and data services remain stable.

* Identify and remove execution blockers across teams, vendors, platforms, and governance forums to keep priority outcomes moving at pace.

Architecture, Governance & Platform Alignment

* Partner with enterprise architecture, platform, security, governance, and product teams to define target-state data, analytics, reporting, and AI architecture.

* Ensure data and AI platforms are aligned with broader cloud, integration, SAP, security, infrastructure, and enterprise architecture strategies.

* Define guardrails for data governance, AI governance, data quality, privacy, access management, resiliency, cost optimization, and operational controls.

* Guide build-vs-buy decisions with a pragmatic view of cost, speed, flexibility, engineering leverage, regulatory requirements, and long-term enterprise value.

Cross-Organizational Influence

* Work collaboratively across Product, SAP, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, AI, Data Governance, and business teams beyond direct reporting lines.

* Influence enterprise decisions impacting data foundations, reporting modernization, AI adoption, platform investment, and cost optimization.

* Drive alignment across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities, ensuring the function remains focused on enterprise outcomes rather than local optimization.

Engineering Excellence & Delivery

* Embed modern engineering practices, including DevOps, automation, CI/CD, testing, observability, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery across data and AI platforms.

* Ensure delivery of scalable, secure, high-quality data platforms, reporting services, AI-enabled capabilities, and outcome-based data products.

* Establish performance, reliability, quality, adoption, value realization, and cost optimization metrics with strong governance controls.

Build and scale high-performing teams with strong ownership, technical depth, delivery discipline, customer orientation, and continuous improvement mindset.  



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a strategic and execution-focused leader who has successfully driven large-scale data, analytics, reporting, AI, or platform transformations in complex enterprise environments.

* Proven experience leading data engineering, analytics, reporting, AI, or data platform teams at scale.

* Demonstrated track record of modernizing fragmented or tool-heavy data landscapes into scalable, governed, and cost-efficient engineering-led capabilities.

* Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, semantic layers, reporting ecosystems, AI platforms, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.

* Experience enabling self-service data access and self-service reporting while maintaining governance, quality, security, privacy, and compliance.

* Strong practical understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, agentic AI use cases, and the data foundations required to deliver them reliably at enterprise scale.

* Ability to make pragmatic build-vs-buy choices and reduce dependency on costly enterprise software where fit-for-purpose alternatives can deliver better outcomes.

* Ability to influence and deliver across teams outside direct span of control while keeping current priorities and commitments on track.

* Strong leadership presence with experience aligning senior stakeholders around data, AI, reporting, cost, risk, and platform priorities.

* Customer- and value-driven mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and focus on measurable business impact.

Ability to coach and develop engineers, uplifting technical capability and establishing a strong data and AI engineering culture.  



Required Skills/Experience

* MS or BS in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, AI/ML, or a science/engineering discipline.

* 18+ years of experience in technology leadership roles, with significant experience in data engineering, analytics, reporting, platform engineering, or AI-enabled products.

* Proven experience driving large-scale transformation and modernization programs across data, analytics, reporting, AI, or platform domains.

* Strong experience with modern data platforms, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, semantic layers, data quality, metadata, governance, and reporting ecosystems.

* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and modern DevOps / platform engineering practices.

* Experience designing scalable architectures that support analytics, self-service reporting, AI/ML, GenAI, and decision intelligence use cases.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across distributed teams and influence senior stakeholders.

* Strong business acumen and ability to balance cost, risk, agility, user experience, reliability, and long-term enterprise value.

title: Senior Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in Verification, verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
* Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem/SoCs in the Networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control desired.
* Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
* Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) Accelerators or vector processing units.
* Experience with the full verification life cycle.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

title: Technical Support Engineer III
description:
**Who is Forcepoint?**

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

**Job Summary:**

A Cybersecurity Technical Support Engineer III is responsible for providing a world-class support experience to our enterprise customer base. Living our corporate values of being Trustworthy, Collaborative, Accountable, Respectful, Innovative, and Relentless, you will be responsible for assisting our customers with troubleshooting and resolving issues related to Forcepoint as well as associated third-party products, enabling our customers to stop the bad and free the good. You will utilize your knowledge and experience to interpret the customers’ needs and ensure they are achieving maximum value from Forcepoint. You will be seen as a technical advisor within the team and called upon to provide assistance to other team members on issues within your area of expertise. You will actively participate in product supportability programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Respond to customer cases in line with Service Level Agreements.
* Proactively identify and resolve potential problems in an effort to prevent them from occurring and improve the overall customer experience.
* Approach each case with a goal of ensuring Forcepoint products are performing at an optimal level by addressing any underlying or additional problems uncovered during each customer engagement.
* Ensure full understanding of the issue, including impact to customer.
* Gather logs, configuration details and attempt to reproduce the reported issues.
* Research the issue in the Knowledge Base, documentation and with your team members as needed.
* Recommend solutions to customers and follow through to resolution or escalate the case in a timely manner if no resolution can be found.
* Prioritize workload based on severity and impact to customer and demonstrate a sense of urgency when handling cases.
* Be accountable for customer escalations and drive them internally to a speedy resolution while ensuring that customers are kept fully informed of progress throughout the escalation.
* Document all interactions and case details within the customer tracking database, including a detailed description of the issue and any resolutions recommended.
* Adhere to company policies and procedures regarding customer handling, case management and service entitlement verification.
* Participate in knowledge sharing via involvement in technical discussions and Knowledge Base documentation.
* Create and deliver formal mentoring programs to Technical Support Engineers
* Provide technical reviews of user documentation, product requirements documents and functional specifications.
* Act as subject matter expert with regard to specific product components and integrations.
* Provide in-depth training in areas of expertise, general product knowledge, and integration.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.
* AI-Assisted Support
* + Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to analyze logs, policies, and errors.
  + Summarize support tickets and identify key issues.
  + Research solutions using AI and documentation.
  + Draft technical responses and tailor them as needed.
  + Create and maintain knowledge base articles.
* undefined

**Person Specification:**

You demonstrate extreme levels of accountability and are results driven; you value teamwork and collaboration; you communicate transparently and with candor, while always being genuine; you act boldly, take initiative and are comfortable taking calculated risks to achieve successful outcomes; you execute with speed and integrity, delivering high quality work product which you are proud of.

***AI at Forcepoint:***

*At Forcepoint, we believe AI is a force multiplier — not a replacement for human ingenuity. We actively encourage every team member to embrace AI tools as part of their daily workflow: to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, surface insights faster, and free up cognitive bandwidth for the work that requires distinctly human judgment, creativity, and collaboration.*

*We are building a workforce that is fluent in AI - one that continuously experiments, learns, and applies emerging tools to deliver greater impact for our customers and mission.*

*People who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a proactive approach to AI-augmented work will thrive here."*

**Required Skills and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Six or more years of experience supporting business to business customers
* Familiarity with Forcepoint DLP, Data Security System Administration, Endpoint Security, Windows, Linux, Mac OS,LDAP/AD, Email and mail flow troubleshooting, Enterprise Cloud Services, Networking basic concepts and connection troubleshooting
* Hands-on experience that demonstrate knowledge of:
* Networking fundamentals (Layer 2 and 3, TCP/IP, 3-way handshake, DNS etc.)
* HTTP protocol (Structure, status codes, authentication, etc.)
* Application Support Basics (Common troubleshooting methodology for Windows and Linux programs)
* SSL/TLS protocols (Structure, certificates, initial handshake, etc.)
* SMTP (Protocol, Routing, MX Records, commands, status/response codes etc.)
* Packet Capture/Analysis with tcpdump and Wireshark
* Diagnosing network latency and intermittent issues
* Reading and analysing log files
* Active Directory (Domains, structure, permissions, group policies, etc.)
* MSSQL fundamentals (Management interface, accessing logs, browsing databases, simple queries, permissions, jobs, etc.)
* Information Security Concepts
* Endpoint application stack diagnostics and analysis for Windows, Mac, and Linux Endpoints
* Windows and Linux memory dump capture and analysis
* Experience supporting the following applications:
* Red Hat Linux fundamentals (command line navigation and basic features, file system, permissions, networking, etc.)
* Windows (Permissions, services, file system, Event Viewer, etc.)

o Experience with at least one AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.).

o Write effective prompts for technical support tasks.

o Validate AI-generated outputs against configurations, documentation, and best practices before use.

o Understand AI limitations (including hallucinations) and apply critical thinking.

o Break down complex issues into structured AI prompts.

Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.*

title: AI Engineer
description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Engineer to join our innovative team.

**AI Engineer | About You**

As an AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and demonstrate AI and machine learning solutions that address real-world business challenges across forecasting, risk scoring, churn prediction, anomaly detection, and optimization. You will work closely with sales engineering, data engineering, and business teams to rapidly translate client requirements into compelling PoCs and scalable AI/ML solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with Python development, cloud-based AI/ML platforms, MLOps fundamentals, and the ability to clearly present technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**AI Engineer | Day-to-Day**

* Design and develop AI/ML PoCs, prototypes, and demonstrations using structured and tabular data for forecasting, risk scoring, churn prediction, optimization, and related business use cases.
* Build, train, tune, and evaluate machine learning models using supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised techniques, including XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, clustering, PCA, anomaly detection, and time-series modeling.
* Develop AI/ML workflows using cloud platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or Databricks ML, supporting scalable model experimentation, training, and deployment.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design data ingestion, preprocessing, feature engineering, and transformation pipelines using Python, Spark, and cloud-native technologies.
* Partner with sales engineering and business stakeholders during pre-sales discussions, demonstrations, and technical workshops, translating business challenges into practical AI/ML solutions and effectively communicating model insights and business value.
* Apply MLOps and AI engineering best practices across model evaluation, explainability, versioning, deployment, performance monitoring, drift detection, and optimization while developing reusable AI assets for transition to delivery teams.

**AI Engineer | Skills & Experience**

* 1+ years of hands-on AI/ML experience, developing and deploying machine learning models in production, prototype, or PoC environments, particularly using structured or tabular datasets.
* Strong proficiency in Python and machine learning libraries, including Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, NumPy, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of applied machine learning techniques, including feature engineering, model tuning, cross-validation, error analysis, clustering, anomaly detection, dimensionality reduction, and time-series modeling.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI/ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks ML, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, deployment automation, model explainability, performance monitoring, and model/data drift detection.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present AI/ML PoCs, technical approaches, model results, and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

**Job Description**

  

**1.1 SIEM G SOAR Engineering (Palo Alto Cortex)**
--------------------------------------------------

• Design, deploy and maintain log source integrations into Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM / XSOAR, ensuring normalisation, parsing accuracy and data quality across all connected sources.

• Develop, test and continuously improve SOAR playbooks for automated triage, enrichment and response across key incident types.

• Own SIEM content including detection rules, correlation policies, dashboards and alert thresholds; perform ongoing tuning to reduce false-positive volumes.

• Maintain platform health including connector status monitoring, API rate-limit management and capacity planning for log ingestion pipelines.

• Produce and maintain engineering documentation including integration runbooks, playbook specifications and change records in accordance with CAB policy.

**1.2 Endpoint Security Engineering (CrowdStrike Falcon)**
----------------------------------------------------------

• Administer and engineer the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including sensor deployment management, policy configuration and response workflow alignment with SOC procedures.

• Configure and maintain Falcon data connectors into the SIEM, ensuring EDR telemetry is enriched and actionable within the detection pipeline.

• Contribute to host-based detection content and work with the SOC team to validate alert fidelity from Falcon- sourced events.

• Support incident response activities requiring Falcon RTR (Real Time Response) capabilities where required.

**1.3 Cloud Security Logging G Integration**
--------------------------------------------

Engineer and maintain security log collection from multi-cloud environments into the SIEM, including:

AWS — configure and operate GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs and S3 access logging; manage event forwarding via EventBridge and SǪS/SNS pipelines.

Azure — configure and maintain Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor Diagnostic Settings and Entra ID audit and sign-in log ingestion.

GCP — configure and maintain Cloud Audit Logs, Security Command Centre findings export and Pub/Sub-based log forwarding into the SIEM.

• Ensure cloud logging coverage aligns with the organisation’s detection requirements and regulatory obligations, and identify and remediate gaps in telemetry coverage.

• Maintain cloud-side IAM roles and service principals used for log collection with least-privilege principles.

**1.4 Microsoft Entra ID G Office 365 Integration**
---------------------------------------------------

• Work alongside the IT team to maintain and improve security-relevant integrations between Entra ID and the SIEM, including Conditional Access policy audit logging, risky sign-in alerting and identity-based detection use cases.

• Support the health and configuration of Microsoft 365 Defender connectors, including Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams audit log ingestion.

• Assist in periodic reviews of Entra ID security configuration posture, including MFA policy coverage, guest account hygiene and privileged role assignments from a security monitoring perspective.

• Act as a technical liaison between Information Security and IT on identity-related security matters, escalating findings through appropriate governance channels.

**1.5 SOC Operations G Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------

• Contribute to the SOC as a Tier 2/3 resource on complex investigations, providing engineering context to support analyst triage.

• Participate in threat-led detection engineering, translating threat intelligence and MITRE ATTCCK TTPs into actionable detection logic.

• Support vulnerability and configuration management activities where they relate to SIEM-connected assets.

• Contribute to weekly and monthly SOC reporting by maintaining the accuracy and completeness of underlying data sources and metrics.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Principal AI Engineer is responsible for the technical design, development and implementation of AI-enabled and automation solutions across GSK’s MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Development Team. The role combines hands-on AI/software engineering with technical leadership to deliver reusable agents, automation components, integrations and engineering tools. Working closely with the MES Automation Manager, the role translates the Global MES AI and automation strategy into practical solutions and drives the technical adoption of AI within the development team. The job holder coordinates AI-related engineering activities, guides and coaches developers, promotes common AI engineering practices and remains hands-on in prototyping, scripting, integration and solution development. The role ensures that AI-enabled solutions are reliable, secure, reusable, measurable and appropriately governed, including evaluation, human oversight, monitoring and traceability. The MES Automation Manager retains accountability for AI/automation strategy, governance and value realization, while the Principal AI Engineer provides the technical leadership and engineering capability required to implement and scale AI within MES Development Team. Drives the delivery and operational support of AI solutions across their lifecycle, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable capabilities that enhance MES developer productivity, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making while delivering measurable business value and user adoption.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, develop, test and implement AI-enabled solutions, agents and automation capabilities supporting the MES Development Team.
* Work with the MES Automation Manager to translate the MES AI and automation strategy into prototypes, (Minimum Viable Product) MVPs and scalable production solutions.
* Lead the technical implementation and adoption of AI within the development team, coordinating AI engineering activities and coaching developers in AI-enabled ways of working.
* Develop reusable AI agents, services, integrations, (Application Programming Interfaces) APIs, automation components and AI-ready knowledge solutions applicable across MES development.
* Apply prompt and context engineering, retrieval/RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agent orchestration and tool integration to build reliable and effective AI solutions.
* Define and execute evaluation, testing, acceptance criteria and monitoring for AI-generated outputs and agent behavior, and implement appropriate human oversight, traceability, logging, access controls and exception handling for AI-enabled solutions.
* Apply professional software engineering practices using technologies such as Python, C#/.NET, SQL, PowerShell, (Representational State Transfer) REST APIs, JSON (JavaScript Object Notation)/XML (eXtensible Markup Language), Git/GitHub, automated testing and code review.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Product, MES Engineering, Infrastructure and other GSK AI and technology teams to align solutions with enterprise platforms, standards and reusable AI capabilities.
* Integrate AI capabilities with approved MES, engineering, knowledge and enterprise data sources, ensuring secure and controlled access, and ensure AI solutions comply with applicable Responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, data integrity, (Good Practice ) GxP, validation and engineering requirements.
* Drive reuse, standardization and continuous improvement of AI engineering practices, components and knowledge across the MES Development Team.
* Use AI coding assistants and agent workflows as the default way of building, testing and documenting, and validates every output before it is committed or released.
* Deliver and support AI solutions across the full lifecycle, including (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) CI/CD, release management, monitoring, incident resolution, and operational support, ensuring >99.5% availability, (Service Level Agreement) SLA compliance, and solution reliability. Drive AI-enabled capabilities that improve MES developer productivity, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making, with success measured through adoption, user satisfaction, delivery efficiency, incident reduction, and realized business value.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences or a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant technical, AI, cloud, integration, automation, data, validation, cyber security or engineering certifications.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on technical engineering experience, including AI/software engineering in complex enterprise or operational technology environments.
* Experience in providing technical leadership for AI solution design, implementation, deployment and adoption, while remaining hands-on in development and problem solving.
* Experience in coordinating cross-functional engineering activities across development, architecture, infrastructure, data, AI/platform teams, vendors and specialist partners.
* Experience in technical troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and solution improvement across AI, software, integration and data layers.
* Experience in assessing technical risks and ensuring security, data integrity, resilience, Responsible AI, compliance and supportability requirements are addressed.
* Experience in coaching developers and supporting adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices, reusable patterns, standards and shared knowledge.
* Experience in supporting technical assurance, validation, audits or regulated-system governance in GxP or comparable controlled environments.
* Experience in collaborating, communicating and organising work effectively across global teams, suppliers and business stakeholders, including influencing decisions and building alignment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in communication, facilitation and stakeholder management, including clearly articulating product decisions, priorities and technology constraints.
* Experience in using data, user feedback, AI and automation opportunities to inform product improvements and business outcomes.
* Experience in working in a collaborative, organized and user-focused way, including proficiency in using AI-powered tools to support productivity, decision-making and delivery quality.|

A/B Testing, Accessibility Standards, Concept Development, Customer Journey Mapping, Design Systems, Design Thinking, Information Architectures, Persona Creation, Problem Framing, Responsive UI, Storytelling, Usability Testing, User Interface (UI) Design, User Research, Wireframing

title: Senior Principal - EUC / MDM Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Be the definitive technical authority for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries experience and interact with their devices. This role owns the architecture, reference designs, technical standards and engineering direction for the entire end user computing estate — laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, meeting rooms, and specialised or regulated endpoints.

Where the Director owns delivery, budget and people, the Principal Architect owns what good looks like technically and holds the organisation to it. This is a hands-on-capable role: the expectation is to prototype, prove and pressure-test designs personally, not solely to review other people's slides.

The Principal Architect is accountable for ensuring the estate is secure by design, cloud-native, automatable, cost-efficient and — critically — genuinely pleasant to use. They are the person who says no to architecture that will not survive contact with 50,000 users, and who can explain why in terms both engineers and executives accept.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target-state architecture for end user computing: platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery, security control placement and telemetry.
* Produce and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, technical standards and architecture decision records (ADRs) — with trade-offs made explicit rather than buried.
* Define the technical roadmap that underpins the EUC strategy: platform migrations, deprecations, convergence of fragmented tooling, and the sequencing that makes it deliverable.
* Continuously evaluate the market — modern management, AI PCs and on-device inference, cloud PC/DaaS economics, zero-trust endpoint models — and separate genuine capability from vendor narrative.
* Act as the design authority for all endpoint change: chair or sit on the EUC architecture review board, approve significant designs, and hold veto on standards deviation.
* Set and police the exception process — make the right path the easy path, and make deviations visible, time-bound and owned.
* Review and assure supplier and MSP technical designs; ensure partners build to the organisation's architecture rather than their own delivery convenience.
* Set engineering standards for configuration-as-code, packaging, testing, release management and rollback across the endpoint estate.
* Prototype and prove new capability in a lab before it reaches production; build the reference implementation the engineering teams then industrialise.
* Mentor and technically develop senior engineers and platform leads; raise the ceiling of the whole team, not just your own output.
* Partner with Cyber Security to embed zero-trust principles at the endpoint: device trust and attestation, conditional access, least privilege, application control, EDR and DLP placement.
* Architect for regulated and validated environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), data residency and privacy obligations, and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation as a designed-in property rather than a manual scramble.
* Own the technical response to endpoint-relevant threat scenarios and drive architectural remediation of systemic vulnerabilities.
* Architect the digital employee experience (DEX) telemetry model: what is measured, how it is collected, where it lands, and how it drives automated remediation.
* Design for self-healing and self-service by default; treat every recurring ticket category as an architectural defect until proven otherwise.
* Translate architecture into business consequence for senior stakeholders — cost, risk, productivity, time-to-value.
* Represent EUC architecture in enterprise architecture forums, security governance, and vendor executive briefings.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional expertise.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Jamf Certified Expert, TOGAF, CISSP or SABSA).

**Area of Specialisation**

* End user computing architecture at global enterprise scale — platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery and telemetry.
* Modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management (Jamf), including co-management, hybrid-to-cloud-native migration and staged ring-based rollout.
* Endpoint security architecture and zero-trust design — device trust, conditional access, application control, EDR/XDR, DLP and secure baselines.
* Regulated and validated endpoint environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, CSV/CSA, data residency and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation designed in.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in IT infrastructure or end user computing, including 5+ years in a principal, lead or enterprise architect capacity with recognised design authority.
* Architecture ownership for an endpoint estate of 20,000+ devices across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
* Expert-level, hands-on-derived command of modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management — sufficient to build the reference implementation personally, not only to specify it.
* Demonstrable advanced scripting and automation portfolio; evidence of configuration-as-code applied to a production endpoint estate.
* Working fluency in enterprise endpoint security and zero-trust architecture, with a track record of co-designing controls alongside a Cyber Security function.
* Led the architecture of at least one large-scale endpoint platform migration or transformation through to production, including the failures and what was learned from them.
* Able to produce architecture documentation of a standard that withstands external audit and supplier scrutiny.
* Proven credibility with both senior engineers and executive stakeholders, in English, in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [5–15]% of the time.

Desirable:

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — with practical GxP/CSV/CSA and Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure.
* Architecture for specialised endpoints: laboratory instrument workstations, manufacturing and shop-floor devices, clinical and field devices, kiosks, shared and multi-user workstations.
Leading a major platform transformation: SCCM-to-Intune migration, Windows 10* 11 at scale, MSP transition, or M&A integration/divestment of an endpoint estate.
* Sustainability-aware design — device longevity, power management, refurbishment and Scope 3 implications of architectural choices.
* Accessibility and assistive technology designed into the standard build rather than bolted on.
* Network fundamentals relevant to endpoints — SASE/ZTNA, split tunnelling, Wi-Fi 6/7, certificate-based network access.
* Contribution to the wider community — open-source tooling, conference speaking, published technical writing, vendor customer advisory boards.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across Windows and macOS internals, modern endpoint management, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, virtual desktop / cloud PC, and mobile — with the judgement to know where tenant-wide standardisation matters and where a business exception is defensible.
* Advanced PowerShell and at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Go) applied to real automation, not toy scripts.
* Configuration-as-code and GitOps discipline — version-controlled endpoint configuration, CI/CD for policy and package deployment, automated testing and staged ring-based rollout as the default way endpoint change is delivered.
* API-first integration — Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, MDM and security tool APIs; designing integrations that survive vendor change.
* Telemetry and data craft — designing measurement into the estate, with competence in the query languages and platforms the data lands in (KQL, Log Analytics, Power BI or equivalent).
* Architectural discipline — reference designs, ADRs, HLD/LLD, and the ability to write clearly enough that others can build from it and external auditors can accept it.
* Trade-off reasoning — cost, risk, experience, security and operability weighed explicitly; comfortable being the person who quantifies the uncomfortable option.
* Scale intuition — designing for 50,000 devices, unreliable networks, disconnected users, and the long tail of exceptions that always exists.
* Technical leadership without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery and vendors by credibility and evidence.
* Executive communication — making architecture legible and decision-ready for non-technical leadership.
* Constructive challenge — able to disagree with a Director, a vendor or a security architect and keep the relationship intact.

Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Design Thinking, Endpoint Encryption, Endpoint Security, End User Services, Financial Operations, Jamf Pro, Network Protocols, Network Security, Zero Trust

title: GenAI Architect - Life Sciences
description:
**Role description**  

**Who we are:**

At UST, we help the world's best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at **UST.com**.

**Summary:**

UST is looking for a **GenAI Architect - Life Sciences** with deep expertise in **Generative AI, Agentic AI, Python, FASTAPI, AWS Cloud, and Software Architecture**. The ideal candidate will have **12+ years of experience** designing and delivering large-scale enterprise applications, with mandatory experience in the **Life Sciences domain**, including Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Diagnostics, Clinical Research, Pharmacovigilance, or Digital Health solutions.

The role demands a hands-on architect who can define solution strategy, drive architecture decisions, build cloud-native AI applications, and lead delivery teams while collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.

**The Opportunity:**

As a **GenAI Architect - Life Sciences**, you will lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade AI solutions leveraging large language models (LLMs), AI agents, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices. You will partner with cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems across Life Sciences and Healthcare domains.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

#### **Architecture & Design**

* Define and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance architectures for GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using Python and FASTAPI.
* Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices for enterprise AI platforms.
* Design AI-powered solutions for Life Sciences use cases including:
  + Clinical Research
  + Pharmacovigilance
  + Regulatory Affairs
  + Medical Affairs
  + Diagnostics & Digital Health
  + Scientific Data Management

#### **Development & Implementation**

* Develop AI-driven applications and services using Python and modern frameworks.
* Build, integrate, and orchestrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents within enterprise ecosystems.
* Apply MLOps and DevOps practices for efficient deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions.
* Develop GenAI-powered capabilities such as:

  + Document intelligence
  + Knowledge management
  + Workflow automation

#### **Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Optimize solutions for scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices.
* Promote continuous improvement and innovation across AI platforms and products.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Python development.
* Proven experience building production-grade APIs and services using FASTAPI.

* Strong expertise in Generative AI and Agentic AI, including:
  + LLMs
  + RAG Architectures
  + AI Agents
  + Prompt Engineering
  + Orchestration Frameworks

* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

* Pharmaceuticals
* Biotechnology
* Medical Devices / IVD
* Clinical Trials & Clinical Research
* Pharmacovigilance
* Regulatory Affairs
* Healthcare Data Platforms
* Digital Health Solutions

Additionally, candidates should demonstrate a strong understanding of:

* Life Sciences business processes
* Regulatory and compliance requirements
* Healthcare and scientific data ecosystems
* Industry-specific workflows and standards

* Agentic AI
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Python
* FASTAPI
* AWS Cloud Services
* Software Architecture
* Cloud-Native Development
* Microservices Architecture
* Distributed Systems
* API Design & Development

* LangChain
* LlamaIndex
* AWS Bedrock
* SageMaker
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* MLOps
* MLflow
* Kubeflow
* Event-Driven Architecture

title: Senior PMT, Cart Building and Consolidation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if you could shape how millions of customers across emerging markets receive their orders — and do it as part of an AI-native product organization built from the ground up? Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) owns basket building and delivery consolidation, one of the most critical levers for reducing cost-to-serve across 12+ international markets including Mexico, Brazil, Australia, India and the Middle East. This is not about layering AI onto existing systems; you will define what AI-native product development looks like at Amazon, designing the team, the roadmap, and the operating model from scratch. As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, you will use first principles thinking and strong judgment to drive major improvements in delivery efficiency and customer convenience at a scale that few roles can offer. This role requires international travel to markets such as Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East to work directly with local teams and customers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for basket building and delivery consolidation across 12+ international markets, making clear trade-offs between customer convenience, cost-to-serve, and speed.
* Design AI-native product capabilities from the ground up, identifying where AI can reshape delivery consolidation rather than incrementally improve existing workflows.
* Partner with engineering, science, design, and country teams to translate local customer needs into scalable, cross-market solutions.
* Define success criteria and metrics that track both adoption and real-world outcomes such as cost savings and customer satisfaction, using data to inform roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to align priorities across the international portfolio, influencing roadmap decisions and building agreement among stakeholders with different market contexts.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a working session alongside engineers and scientists reviewing how an AI model performs on delivery consolidation recommendations, followed by a call with a country team to understand local cart-building patterns. After lunch you could be writing a product requirements document or building a prototype for a new consolidation feature, then joining an architecture review to talk through scalability trade-offs. You will travel to key markets- Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East, to work directly with customers and local teams, making sure the products you build reflect real-world needs across the international footprint.  
  
About the team  
We sit within Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX), where our mission is to help customers across emerging markets build smarter carts and receive their orders more conveniently and efficiently. Basket building and delivery consolidation is one of three strategic pillars for International Emerging Stores, and our charter carries high visibility and direct senior leadership sponsorship. We are building an AI-native organization from day one, and the work we do here will set the standard for how Amazon approaches AI-driven product development internationally. If you are excited about tackling large-scale, ambiguous problems that touch millions of customers and growing by shaping customer-facing delivery experiences across some of the world's fastest-growing markets, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
