title: Engineering Manager - Data
description:
**Who We Are.**

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**

You will lead Axi's global Data team, which owns the company's data end-to-end: ingestion, modelling, reporting, and alerting. Our platform runs in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem, with Databricks and ClickHouse as core data platforms and dbt for pipelines and data validation, supporting a 24/7 trading business.

**Your EDGE Assignment/You Will**

* Lead and grow a distributed team of data engineers and analytics engineers building Axi's data platform on Azure, Databricks, and ClickHouse.
* Own all data elements end-to-end: ingestion, data models, pipelines, reporting, dashboards, and alerting.
* Set technical direction for the data architecture, including modelling standards, data contracts, and the right use of Databricks vs. ClickHouse.
* Drive dbt-based pipeline development, testing, and data validation so the business can trust its numbers.
* Own data governance and security: cataloguing, lineage, access control, PII protection, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure reliability and cost efficiency of the platform through clear SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and CI/CD for data.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and engineering PODs to prioritise data needs and deliver trusted reporting.

**Are you the one?**

* Strong hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and advanced SQL.
* Experience with ClickHouse or similar real-time analytical databases, including schema design and performance tuning.
* Solid dbt experience: modelling, testing, documentation, and data quality frameworks.
* Good knowledge of Azure data services: ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Purview.
* Strong grasp of data governance and security: RBAC, row/column-level security, encryption, masking, auditing, and retention.
* Experience with reporting and alerting tools (Power BI or similar) and CI/CD for data (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions).

Experience and Skills

* 7–14 years in data engineering, with 3+ years leading data teams as a tech lead or engineering manager.
* Proven track record delivering reliable data platforms and reporting in fintech, trading, or other regulated, high-volume environments.
* Comfortable working in an Agile setup with global stakeholders across time zones.

* Competitive and attractive compensation.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**  
As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be part of a highly skilled talented Customer Support team who work with CrowdStrike customers globally. The role involves working with CrowdStrike internal teams to resolve customer problems including troubleshooting, identification of root cause and issue resolution to help them receive the most benefit from their investment. The ideal candidate will have the energy and drive to discover and learn new technologies. Be fanatical about the customer, relentlessly focused on innovation and have limitless passion to drive their unlimited potential. This is a high energy, fast paced working environment that helps CrowdStrike achieve customer success.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be part of a highly skilled Customer Support team who support CrowdStrike customers 24x7 globally.Work in a dynamic and exciting technical environment with relentless focus on delighting our customers, partners and teammates.
* Demonstrate ownership of customer’s concerns - assess impact, troubleshoot logically, engage relevant stakeholders, identify root cause and resolve them to the satisfaction of our customers.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with them to resolve customer escalations quickly.
* Work with Product experts/Engineering to fix bugs or enhance product features.

* Learn cutting edge technologies and new product features.
* Create/Share Knowledge articles and contribute to mentoring/training efforts.

**What You’ll Need:**

  

* Experience in a Product Technical support role supporting Global enterprise customers.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills.
* Customer focus. Analytical thinking and Logical troubleshooting aptitude.
* Proven experience in troubleshooting and diagnosing issues at the application and operating system level within either Windows, Linux or Mac environments.

* Hands on experience using the tools and techniques to debug problems within either Windows, Linux or Mac environments.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

* Good understanding of TCP/IP and troubleshoot network issues using Wireshark/PCAP analysis.
* Operational understanding of networking devices such as Routers, Switches and Firewalls would be a plus.

**Cloud Technologies:**

* Experience working and troubleshooting in a SaaS cloud environment.
* Proven experience debugging and troubleshooting customer facing API/REST interfaces at both the JSON/HTTPS browser/client side and server-side web service termination, but also navigating within the backend cloud architecture which is responsible for fielding the request.

* Familiarity with cloud orchestration tools like Docker, Kubernetes, etc.

Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

title: Support Engineering Intern
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**The Position**

We are looking for a Support Engineering Intern to join our Level 1 technical support team for six months. You will work alongside experienced engineers on live customer cases: investigating issues, reproducing them in lab environments, and helping customers deploy and configure our products. This is not a shadowing program. From your first weeks you will own real tickets, with a mentor beside you.

We are especially interested in people who are curious about AI and automation. Every case we handle is different, and getting to an answer means digging through logs, documentation, and past investigations. AI and good internal tooling can make that work sharper and faster — better search across our knowledge base, quicker log analysis, cleaner first drafts of technical documentation. If that is something you enjoy exploring, you will have room to experiment here and a team that will adopt what proves useful.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Issue Management**

* Work the queue of open support tickets alongside your mentor, helping ensure timely resolution.

* Investigate and diagnose reported technical issues — gather information, reproduce the problem, and narrow down the cause.

* Search internal knowledge systems (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, past tickets, product documentation, internal wikis) to find solutions before escalating.

* Escalate complex cases to senior engineers with clear, well-documented troubleshooting notes.

* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers via email, chat, and ticketing tools.

**Technical Assistance & Troubleshooting**

* Help customers with installation, configuration, and integration of OPSWAT products.

* Build and maintain lab environments used to reproduce customer scenarios.

* Work with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to get to the bottom of technical challenges.

**AI & Automation (where you can make a mark)**

* Identify repetitive, manual steps in the daily support workflow and propose ways to automate them.

* Use AI assistants responsibly to speed up research, draft case summaries, and produce first-pass knowledge base content — always with human review before anything reaches a customer..

* Help the team evaluate AI-assisted support tooling and share what works and what doesn't.

* Contribute to prompt libraries, internal documentation, and reusable templates the wider support organization can use.

**Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**

* Keep accurate records of customer interactions and resolutions in the ticketing system.

* Write and update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.

**Learning & Growth**

* Complete OPSWAT product and cybersecurity training, including certifications through the OPSWAT Academy.
* Keep up with product updates, new features, and security industry developments.

**What We're Looking For**

*You do not need professional experience. We care far more about how you think and how quickly you learn.*

* Currently studying toward a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field — or a recent graduate.

* Available for the full 6 months, at least 30 hours per week.

* Comfortable with Windows and Linux: you can navigate a filesystem, read a log, install software, and use a terminal without hesitation.

* Basic understanding of networking — TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls.

* Strong analytical instincts: you like breaking a problem apart rather than guessing at it.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Genuine curiosity about AI and automation — and ideally, something you have already built or automated, even if small. A script, a bot, a hobby project, a workflow you tidied up. We would love to hear about it.

* A collaborative attitude and the confidence to ask questions early.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar — applied to real tasks rather than just tried out.

* Scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

* Familiarity with ticketing systems (Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Salesforce Service Cloud).

* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

* Interest in cybersecurity concepts: malware analysis, threat detection, secure file transfer, or OT/ICS environments.

* Personal projects, hackathons, CTFs, or open-source contributions.

title: AI Platform Engineer II
description:
**Job Purpose :**

  

As Enterprise AI’s delivery portfolio grows and GenAI and agentic solutions move from pilot to production, the platform must scale reliably and safely. The AI Platform Engineer owns significant areas of that platform — ensuring they operate at SLO, building automation against routine operations work, embedding security and responsible AI controls into the platform layer, and contributing to the vendor and standards conversations that shape the platform’s direction.

* **Owns significant platform areas** with genuine accountability for reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency of AI services — not just task execution.
* **Makes AI consumable at enterprise scale** by operating the gateways, model endpoints, and context services through which every team reaches models, tools, and data.
* **Builds platform leverage** through automation, self-service, and reusable components that reduce manual operations work across the team.
* **Embeds governance by design** so that AI security, data protection, and responsible AI controls are enforced by the platform rather than negotiated project by project.
* **Develops the next generation** by mentoring junior and mid-level platform engineers, building team capability over time.

**Responsibilities**:

  

* At least 6 years of experience running SaaS, cloud, or platform-engineering services in a production setting, including at least 2 years operating AI/ML or GenAI workloads or services.
* Strong proficiency in Python; working proficiency in at least one additional language (for example, Go, TypeScript, or Java).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform; Bicep a plus), GitOps, and modern CI/CD.
* Hands-on experience operating API gateways or AI/LLM gateways, including routing, rate limiting, authentication, and policy enforcement for AI traffic.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic patterns — tool calling, orchestration, and agent frameworks — and of how context is retrieved, managed, and governed for LLM applications.
* Experience operating production services with defined SLOs, observability, and incident management.
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as a primary development mode.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, secrets management, and data protection for cloud and AI services.

**Required skills:**

  

* **Platform & Cloud:** Kubernetes, containers, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, DevSecOps, platform reliability engineering, and at least one major cloud (Azure preferred) with multi-cloud and hybrid architecture awareness.
* **AI Gateway & API Management:** API gateway patterns, AI/LLM gateway architecture and operations, traffic management, and policy enforcement.
* **GenAI Operations:** LLM deployment, versioning, and monitoring; prompt and evaluation workflows; RAG architectures; vector search fundamentals.
* **MCP & Agents:** Model Context Protocol, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and an understanding of agent orchestration frameworks and context engineering.
* **Observability:** Metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting (for example, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or cloud-native equivalents) applied to AI services.
* **Security:** IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, network security, and data privacy controls for AI workloads.

**Education** :

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, or SRE is advantageous.

**Preferred skills:**

* **Azure AI services** (Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, Azure API Management), with AWS and GCP AI services (for example, Bedrock, Google Cloud AI platform) desired.
* **Model serving and GPU infrastructure:** inference runtimes (for example, vLLM, KServe, Triton), GPU scheduling, and autoscaling.
* **Vector and retrieval stacks:** vector databases and hybrid search (for example, pgvector, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, or dedicated vector stores).
* **Agent and LLM frameworks:** LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable; agent interoperability protocols; evaluation tooling.
* **Gateway technologies:** Kong AI Gateway or comparable (for example, Envoy-based gateways, LiteLLM, Portkey, Azure API Management).
* **Platform tooling:** Databricks, policy-as-code (OPA/Kyverno), service mesh, internal developer platforms (for example, Backstage), and FinOps for AI (token economics and unit-cost reporting).

**AI security & resilience:** guardrail frameworks, AI red-teaming, and resilience testing of AI services

**Skills**

AI Systems, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Cloud Document AI, Identity Access Management (IAM)

title: Technical Consultant (Postgres/MSSQL)
description:

title: Principal Engineer - Data Engineering Architect
description:
**About This Role**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Principal Engineer / Architect ( Data Engineering** )to define and advance the data information strategy, information models, data sourcing standards, and data enablement roadmap across Enterprise Risk, Audit, and Finance Technology.

This is a horizontal architecture role supporting multiple business and technology domains, including Financial Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, Internal Audit, Independent Testing, Model Risk, and Financial Crimes.

The role will shape how enterprise information is identified, defined, sourced, modeled, governed, integrated, and made consumable across ERAFT. The role will establish common information models, semantic standards, authoritative-source guidance, reusable data products, and architecture patterns that enable consistent reporting, analytics, regulatory traceability, and artificial intelligence use cases.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of information architecture, enterprise data architecture, financial-services and banking domain knowledge, data governance, sourcing strategy, semantic modeling, integration design, analytics enablement, and stakeholder leadership. This individual must be able to work independently, influence decisions across business and technology teams, and translate complex business, regulatory, and technology requirements into practical and scalable data architecture.

**In This Role, You Will**

  

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 7+ years of experience in data architecture, information architecture, enterprise architecture, information modeling, or data-platform design.

* 7+ years of experience supporting banking, financial services, finance, risk, audit, regulatory reporting, compliance, or control-related domains.
* Strong Experience in APIs, Kafka or event streaming, ETL and ELT, data virtualization, data lakes, lakehouse platforms, and enterprise data warehouses.
* Experience with technologies such as Dremio, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Python, SQL, Neo4J, Protégé, object storage, and metadata or catalog platforms.

**Desired Qualifications:**

**Data Information Strategy and Architecture**

* Define and own the data information strategy and target-state information architecture across ERAFT.
* Develop current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures covering information domains, data sourcing, information models, metadata, lineage, data products, semantic access, integration, and consumption.
* Define canonical information models and common business concepts that can be reused across Risk, Finance, Audit, regulatory reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Establish standards and artifacts for conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, ontologies, business glossaries, source-to-target mappings, data flows, data lineage views, and semantic relationships.
* Align ERAFT information architecture with enterprise data, metadata, privacy, security, retention, records-management, and regulatory standards.
* Define architecture principles that enable common information to be understood and reused while allowing justified domain-specific extensions.
* Produce architecture specifications, decision records, reference models, roadmaps, standards, and executive-level recommendations.
* Develop POC’s and demos to supplement architecture materials.

**Data Sourcing Strategy**

* Define reusable data sourcing strategies across ERAFT business and technology domains.
* Identify authoritative systems of record, systems of reference, authoritative distribution sources, and trusted consumption sources for critical enterprise information.
* Establish criteria for selecting the appropriate sourcing approach, including direct-source integration, authoritative data products, APIs, event streams, batch feeds, data warehouses, data lakes, data virtualization, federated queries, and metadata-driven ingestion.
* Define sourcing patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured information.
* Partner with source-system owners, data owners, and data stewards to assess data availability, ownership, quality, lineage, refresh frequency, historical coverage, access restrictions, and regulatory obligations.
* Determine whether information should be physically ingested, virtually accessed, indexed, summarized, referenced, or exposed through a governed data product.
* Reduce duplicate sourcing, unnecessary data movement, point-to-point integration, and inconsistent transformation logic.
* Define data contracts that document schema, semantics, quality expectations, service levels, usage constraints, and change-management responsibilities between producers and consumers.

**Information Modeling and Semantic Alignment**

* Develop and maintain enterprise and domain-level information models across ERAFT.
* Standardize business concepts, definitions, relationships, taxonomies, and metrics across Risk, Finance, Audit, and related regulatory domains.
* Define semantic relationships among customers, accounts, products, transactions, legal entities, positions, risks, controls, models, obligations, issues, findings, evidence, business processes, reports, and organizational structures.
* Partner with business data owners and governance teams to approve common definitions and resolve semantic conflicts.
* Support subject-area taxonomy alignment, conceptual modeling, glossary analysis, ontology evaluation, and capability mapping.
* Define semantic-layer patterns that separate business meaning from physical data structures and technology implementations.
* Evaluate ontology and knowledge-graph approaches where they improve cross-domain discovery, traceability, impact analysis, aggregation, or AI-enabled access.
* Promote reuse of common information concepts while preserving appropriate business context for individual domains.

**Data Governance, Quality, Metadata, and Lineage**

* Define information-governance requirements for ERAFT data products, platforms, and solutions.
* Partner with data owners and stewards to establish accountability for business terms, data domains, data products, and Critical Data Elements.
* Define data-quality expectations for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity, consistency, and uniqueness.
* Establish patterns for data controls, reconciliation, validation, observability, and issue remediation.
* Define end-to-end lineage requirements from authoritative sources through ingestion, transformation, semantic models, reports, analytics, models, AI solutions, and downstream consumers.
* Establish metadata requirements that support discovery, reuse, impact analysis, auditability, explain ability, and regulatory response.
* Ensure that information architecture addresses privacy, security, entitlements, data classification, retention, records management, and permitted use.

**Data Enablement, Analytics, and AI**

* Define the data foundation required to support dashboards, reports, analytics, advanced monitoring, and AI-enabled insights.

* Enable governed AI access to business glossaries, metadata, lineage, quality indicators, relationships, and approved enterprise knowledge.
* Ensure that AI-enabled consumption is explainable, auditable, secured, and aligned with applicable governance expectations.
* Promote an information-first approach in which AI solutions consume governed enterprise context rather than creating isolated copies and conflicting definitions.

**Integration and Data-Platform Architecture**

* Partner with enterprise architects, application architects, platform architects, solution architects, and engineering teams to translate information architecture into implementable solutions.
* Define patterns for APIs, event streaming, batch ingestion, ETL and ELT, files, data virtualization, federated queries, and metadata-driven connectors.

* Align information architecture with enterprise cloud, hybrid, on-premises, analytics, and integration standards.
* Provide data-architecture input to platform selection, vendor assessment, and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Guide modernization from fragmented legacy data flows to governed, reusable, and interoperable enterprise capabilities.
* Maintain a clear separation between business information architecture, logical data architecture, and physical technology implementation.

**Stakeholder Management and Architecture Governance**

* Act as a trusted information-architecture adviser to business, data, technology, architecture, risk, finance, audit, compliance, and control leaders.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical information and data architecture decisions.
* Facilitate decisions involving information ownership, authoritative sourcing, semantic definitions, quality expectations, data sharing, and consumption patterns.

* Lead and contribute to architecture reviews, design reviews, data-governance forums, and platform decision-making bodies.
* Independently drive architecture decisions while balancing risk, cost, regulatory requirements, delivery commitments, and long-term sustainability.
* Document major sourcing, modeling, semantic, integration, and platform decisions through architecture decision records.
* Identify architecture risks, dependencies, gaps, exceptions, and remediation requirements.
* Mentor architects, data modelers, analysts, and engineers in information-architecture practices.

**Job Expectations:**

The Principal Engineer - Lead Architect will be expected to:

  

* Experience spanning multiple Risk, Finance, Audit, Treasury, Financial Crimes, Model Risk, regulatory, or enterprise data-management domains.
* Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, business glossaries, data lineage, data-quality platforms, data products, and data contracts.
* Experience with semantic layers, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or enterprise information models.
* Understanding of data mesh, data fabric, authoritative data sources, and contract-driven data distribution.
* **Experience with APIs, Kafka or event streaming, ETL and ELT, data virtualization, data lakes, lakehouse platforms, and enterprise data warehouses.**
* **Experience with technologies such as Dremio, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Python, SQL, Neo4J, Protégé, object storage, and metadata or catalog platforms.**
* Familiarity with graph technologies, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise large-language-model platforms, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience defining governed data patterns for AI, including source traceability, context, lineage, human validation, explainability, and auditability.
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent.
* Relevant architecture, information-management, cloud, data-governance, or security certification.

* Establish a clear and executable data information strategy across ERAFT.
* Define reusable information models and semantic standards across Risk, Finance, and Audit.
* Improve clarity around authoritative sources, data ownership, business definitions, and consumption patterns.
* Promote reuse of governed data products, reference data, metadata, and integration patterns.

* Enable consistent reporting, analytics, regulatory use, and AI-enabled capabilities.

description:

**Job Purpose**

The Director, Digital Platforms & Integration is accountable for defining, delivering and continuously evolving the foundational digital platforms, integration capabilities and information frameworks that enable GSK's future smart manufacturing, supply chain and CMC digital ecosystem.

The role leads the strategy, execution and operational performance of the Factory Integration Layer (FIL) as a critical enterprise capability connecting manufacturing systems, laboratory platforms, engineering applications, cloud services and business processes. The position ensures that platform and integration investments create reusable, scalable and technology-agnostic capabilities that accelerate business outcomes across sites, functions and products.

The Director is accountable for the Azure Local migration strategy, establishing a modern, secure and resilient hybrid foundation for digital products, analytics, AI and industrial data solutions across the manufacturing network.

As a key leader within the CMC Acceleration Program, the role owns delivery and integration of enterprise ontologies, knowledge-management capabilities, data pipelines and information architectures that transform fragmented data into connected, contextualized and actionable knowledge. The position enables digital thread capabilities across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, quality and supply chain operations.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Experience leading Factory Integration Layer, industrial integration, OT/IT convergence, edge computing or comparable manufacturing-platform capabilities.

* Demonstrated delivery of ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, knowledge-management integrations, data pipelines or digital-thread capabilities.

* Demonstrated ability to resolve strategic trade-offs across value, cost, capacity, architecture, data, cyber security, compliance and business continuity.
* Experience influencing Director and VP stakeholders and representing platform delivery in investment, architecture, data, risk and transformation forums.
* Strong experience managing cross-platform dependencies, supplier contributions, complex migrations and global release sequencing.
* Experience strengthening ways of working, coaching technical talent and building sustainable platform, integration and knowledge-management capabilities.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Enterprise architecture and systems thinking, with the ability to connect business capability, information, integration, infrastructure and service views.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos.

You will:

* Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service.

* Design and build **agent runtimes and harnesses**: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Design, build and secure **MCP servers and clients**, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs.

* Integrate and serve **LLMs**, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control.

* Build **ModelOps / LLMOps** pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring.

* Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics.

* Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries.

* Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness.

* Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

* Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store.

* Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area.

* Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives.
  

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts **across India and Silicon Valley**, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

You’ll also work cross-functionally with:

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.

* Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries.

* Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production.

* Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD.

* Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering.

* Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models.

* Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent.

* Experience with **ModelOps / LLMOps**: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production.

* Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost.

* Proficiency in **Python** (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems.

* Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling).

* Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation).

* Experience implementing **AI guardrails**, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense.

* Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI.

title: Sr AI Engineer
description:
**About the team**

Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We're building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation.

  

**About the role**

We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data.

You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions.
* Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems.
* Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs.
* Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling.
* Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems.
* Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts.
* Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time.
* Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused.

**Experience you’ll need (must haves)**

* Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes.
* Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces.
* A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here.

**Software engineering skills and best practices**

* System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures.
* Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance.
Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents.
* Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production.

**AI engineering skills and best practices**

* Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on.
* Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load.
* Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows.
* Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition.

**Preferred qualifications (nice to haves)**

* Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval.
* Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms.
* Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks.
* Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores.
* UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output.

title: ASIC Engineer, Physical Design CAD
description:
Meta's silicon engineering team is building custom infrastructure silicon to power the compute demands of AI, data center, and next-generation hardware platforms. The Infra Silicon Implementation CAD team owns the physical design flows and automation that take our designs from RTL handoff through synthesis, place and route, timing closure, and physical signoff. As a Physical Design CAD engineer, you will be responsible for building and owning the flow infrastructure used daily by PD engineers across concurrent tapeout programs. This is a high-leverage role: the automation you build directly determines how quickly a chip organization converges.  
  
  

### **ASIC Engineer, Physical Design CAD Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and own stages of the digital physical design flow — synthesis, floorplanning and design planning, placement, CTS, routing, extraction, timing ECO, and STA signoff
* Build and extend flow automation in Python and Tcl, integrated with Meta’s internal build, job-scheduling, and continuous integration infrastructure
* Partner with PD engineers and design leads to debug flow and Quality of Release (QoR) issues on active tapeout programs, and convert recurring workarounds into supported flow features
* Qualify and integrate commercial EDA tools, drive issues to resolution with vendor application-engineering teams, and manage tool version migrations across programs
* Build constraint and netlist validation capability so design-intent errors are caught in-flow rather than at sign-off
* Develop QoR tracking, metrics, and dashboards that give design teams and program leadership visibility into convergence across blocks and subsystems
* Write and maintain user-facing flow documentation and training, and support designers as part of a shared on-call rotation
* Collaborate with external design partners and foundry or ASIC vendors on flow alignment and design handoff criteria

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, and/or equivalent practical experience
* 2+ years of experience in either ASIC physical design or CAD, including hands-on work with automation, flow development, drafting methodologies, solutions, and/or hands-on work with placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure
* Experience with digital physical design implementation on advanced process nodes, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Hands-on experience with industry physical design tools, such as Fusion Compiler, Genus, Innovus, PrimeTime, Tempus, or StarRC
* Proficiency in Tcl and Python for EDA flow development and automation
* Experience debugging flow, timing, or physical verification issues on a production tapeout
* Experience with version control and collaborative code review

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working across geographically distributed teams and with external design partners
* Experience with power integrity and EM/IR analysis, and/or physical verification and logic equivalence sign-off
* Experience with timing constraint development and validation methodology, including SDC generation and constraint checking
* Experience building or owning a production CAD or physical design flow used by multiple design teams
* Experience building data pipelines or dashboards for design metrics and QoE analysis
* Experience with compute and license capacity management for large EDA workloads
* Experience applying AI or LLM-based tooling to engineering workflows
* Experience with hierarchical design planning and block-level partitioning on large SoCs

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer**

Join AMD’s PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems.
* Validate AI frameworks and runtimes (**PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime**)
* Execute and optimize workloads on **ROCm/HIP, CUDA, OpenCL, and heterogeneous accelerators**
* Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock.
* Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination.
* SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging.
* Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions.
* Navigation & Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance).
* Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15.06.
* Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors.
* CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage.
* Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years in QA/Validation, with 9+ years in robotics or AMR systems.
* Strong Python for automation and C++ for ROS2 integration.
* Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).
* Expertise in LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, odometry, and sensor calibration.
* Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol.
* CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments.
* Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849).

**Preferred Skills**

* Multi-robot coordination, dynamic obstacle handling, and SLAM algorithms.
* Robotics AMR safety PLCs, zone scanners, and emergency stop circuits.
* Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA.
* Performance benchmarking, reliability testing, and telemetry dashboards.

**Success Metrics**

* Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios.
* Reduction in field defect escape rate.
* Stability and reliability under multi-robot deployments.
* Compliance with safety standards and successful audits.

**Academic Credentials:**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Robotics**, **Electronics**, **Mechatronics**, **Computer Science**, or a related field.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

  

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

  
  

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  
  

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.
  

  

You're Our Person If...

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.
  

  

Even Better If...

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

title: Senior AI/ML Trainer
description:

**Good to have:**

Pay: ₹665,000.00 - ₹1,940,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
