title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**

**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos.

You will:

* Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service.

* Design and build **agent runtimes and harnesses**: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Design, build and secure **MCP servers and clients**, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs.

* Integrate and serve **LLMs**, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control.

* Build **ModelOps / LLMOps** pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring.

* Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics.

* Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries.

* Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness.

* Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

* Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store.

* Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions.

* Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives.
  

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts **across India and Silicon Valley**, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

You’ll also work cross-functionally with:

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.

* Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries.

* Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production.

* Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD.

* Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering.

* Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models.

* Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent.

* Experience with **ModelOps / LLMOps**: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production.

* Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost.

* Proficiency in **Python** (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems.

* Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling).

* Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation).

* Experience implementing **AI guardrails**, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense.

* Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI.

* Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads.

**#LI-PG1**

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Assistant Director - Automation and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Director – Automation and Artificial Intelligence

**Purpose of the role:**

The Assistant Director – Automation and Artifical Intelligence will provide specialist expertise in code-based automation, advanced scripting and applied AI/GenAI to simplify processes, improve productivity and create intelligent capabilities across People Insights products. Working through the Product Lead, the role will translate requirements into scalable automation and AI solutions using Python, R and other programming technologies, with Microsoft 365 and Power Platform capabilities providing additional solution options.

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop and maintain code-based automation solutions using Python, R and other programming or scripting languages to eliminate repetitive manual activities, improve productivity and increase process consistency.
* Analyse business processes and product requirements to identify opportunities for automation, intelligent processing and AI, translating requirements received through the Product Lead into practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Build reusable automation capabilities for data extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, reporting, file processing, workflow execution and exception handling, integrating with databases, APIs, enterprise applications and data platforms where required.
* Develop robust and maintainable solutions with appropriate error handling, logging, monitoring, documentation and recovery mechanisms, ensuring reliability and operational resilience at scale.
* Apply AI and machine-learning techniques to use cases including classification, summarisation, information extraction, document processing, prediction and natural-language interaction, selecting the most appropriate approach based on the business problem.
* Develop and evaluate AI solutions, assessing accuracy, relevance, consistency and reliability while addressing hallucination, inappropriate outputs, data privacy, security, explainability and responsible AI risks.
* Work closely with the Product Lead, Data Engineering, Application Development and QA teams to understand priorities, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, risks and implementation options, supporting Agile delivery and productionisation.
* Continuously improve and manage the lifecycle of automation and AI solutions by applying emerging technologies such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, Microsoft Power Platform, Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and modern development frameworks, while ensuring effective testing, deployment, troubleshooting, documentation and handover.

**To be successful you will:**

* Six or more years of experience in automation, software development, data engineering, analytics engineering, AI/ML or a related technical discipline.Strong programming and scripting fundamentals, with experience in technologies such as SQL, JavaScript, C#, Java, PowerShell or equivalent.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Be Part of Us:

Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are empowering companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to join our AI innovation team and help drive the adoption of AI-powered solutions within the banking industry.

In this role, you will combine hands-on AI engineering with customer engagement and solution delivery responsibilities. You will work closely with customers -especially in ANZ and APAC - to understand business requirements, shape AI use cases, and support the successful implementation of AI capabilities in real-world banking environments.

You will also coordinate a small team of AI engineers and help ensure timely and high-quality delivery while remaining actively involved in solution design and development.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions for our banking products.
* Work directly with customers to understand business needs and translate requirements into practical AI solutions.
* Drive customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and solution reviews throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate a small team of AI engineers and support the planning and execution of development activities.
* Ensure successful delivery of AI initiatives by aligning customer expectations, delivery progress, and product capabilities.
* Contribute hands-on to software development, AI implementation, experimentation, and prototyping activities.
* Collaborate closely with product management, engineering teams, solution experts, and customer-facing teams.
* Support the rollout and adoption of AI capabilities at customer sites.
* Identify opportunities for additional AI use cases and help customers maximize the value of AI technologies.
* Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and contribute ideas for future product enhancements.

  
**Requirements**

Job Requirements:

* Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Several years of experience in software engineering and AI solution development.
* Experience working directly with customers, managing requirements, and supporting solution delivery.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies and enterprise AI architectures.
* Strong programming skills (Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar).
* Experience with cloud-native development and container technologies (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical AI solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience coordinating delivery activities across distributed teams.
* Experience within banking, financial services, or regulated industries is a plus.
* Willingness for regular travel to APAC (in particular Australia+ New Zealand) to drive our work with the clients in the region.

  
**Benefits**

Benefits:

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

Join us for a rewarding career where your needs are not just met but exceeded

title: Consulting Engineer

description:

Design, build, and deploy AI/LLM-integrated solutions for FP&A, accounting, audit, and reporting workflows; maintain all code in Git with version control and peer review.

Python (or equivalent) for automation and data pipeline work.

Cloud platform experience (Azure/AWS preferred).

Git-based version control, structured code review, and change management practices.

SQL and ETL/data pipeline experience.

Working familiarity with low-code/RPA platforms (Power Platform, UiPath, Copilot Studio), with enough depth to competently review, not necessarily build in them.

Understanding of AI governance concepts: model validation, drift detection, data lineage, audit trails.

Able to explain technical risk in plain language to non-technical finance staff whose builds are under review.

Working knowledge of finance processes sufficient to judge business context and materiality of a given AI build.

Comfortable working across business units with varying technical maturity.

Finance/accounting background or FP&A exposure.

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

**3. Base Management Innovation**

* Transform traditional Customer Value Management (CVM) into a continuous, real-time, AI-native discipline.
* Develop scalable algorithms for causal inference and uplift modeling to ensure AI interventions generate true incremental value (A/B testing at scale).
* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deploy AI solutions that fundamentally alter the economics of customer retention and growth.

**4. Mentorship & Eminence**

* Act as a technical mentor and sponsor for Principal Scientists, Senior Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists across the organization.
* Drive a culture of engineering and scientific excellence, establishing rigorous standards for model validation, MLOps, AI safety, and ethical AI.
* Represent the company in the broader AI community through conference presentations, whitepapers, open-source contributions, and patent filings.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a closely related highly quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 12+ years of applied R&D experience in AI/ML, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Principal Engineer, Chief Scientist, or equivalent).

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a **hands-on AI/ML Engineer** to join our **Information Systems (IS)**.

This is a **specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with **Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

**Work model:** Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from **SAP and Salesforce** to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from **Snowflake** and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including **Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions**.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, **cost monitoring, root-cause analysis**, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry**: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake AI/ML tools** (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating **SAP and Salesforce** data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
* Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Mainframe Application Support Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

There’s never a typical day as a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for mainframe applications built on Natural and Adabas, ensuring high availability and operational stability.
* Monitor application performance, troubleshoot incidents, and resolve production issues within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis of application failures and implement preventive solutions to minimize recurring issues.
* Support batch processing, online transactions, job scheduling, and production release activities across environments.
* Collaborate with business users, development teams, and infrastructure teams to drive timely issue resolution and service improvements.
Maintain operational documentation, support change and release management processes, and ensure compliance with security, audit, and business continuity requirements.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 4+ Years of experience in Mainframe Application Support with a focus on Natural and Adabas technologies.
* Proven experience working in IBM z/OS environments with solid knowledge of JCL, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, and mainframe utilities.
* Good understanding of CICS, VSAM, batch processing, job scheduling, and production support operations.
* Experience supporting mission-critical applications in a 24x7 production environment, including incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Hands-on experience with scheduling and monitoring tools such as CA-7, Control-M, OPC/TWS, or equivalent.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and data correction skills for Natural/Adabas applications.
* Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools for incident and service request management.
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global teams.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Familiarity with application deployment, release management, and environment migration activities.
* Knowledge of Adabas performance monitoring, database support fundamentals, and application optimization techniques.
* Exposure to ITIL-based service management practices and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Experience participating in on-call production support, major incident management, and disaster recovery exercises.
Understanding of automation, operational efficiency, and proactive monitoring practices within mainframe environments.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).

title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

title: Senior Principal - Automation / Prompt / Agent Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

**Business Stakeholders**

* Business stakeholders sponsoring platform capability with architectural consequence
* Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

**Tech Stakeholders**

  

* Platform Architecture Director as owner of domain target architecture
* Platform engineering teams applying the patterns and standards
* Product Owner and Platform Manager for roadmap and backlog consequence
* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects for enterprise alignment
* Information Security and Reliability Engineering for security and resilience standards

**Other**

  

* Managed service partners whose solution designs must meet platform architecture standards
* Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

  

* Typically 15+ years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Desirable**

* Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale.
* Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start.
* Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial).
* Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability.

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

Architectural Review, Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Design Assurance, Digital Fluency, Digital Workplace, GxP Regulations, GxPs, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance, Technology Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

title: Engineering Manager, Software Engineering - CD
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Harness is seeking an exceptional Engineering Manager to lead the team building the **Harness Cloud platform**, the infrastructure foundation powering Continuous Delivery (CD) and several other Harness products. This is a unique opportunity to lead engineers building one of the industry's most scalable cloud-native execution platforms, responsible for securely orchestrating build infrastructure across thousands of virtual machines, Kubernetes clusters, and bare-metal systems.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a highly technical team responsible for architecting, scaling, securing, and operating the cloud platform that powers millions of build executions. You'll partner closely with Product Management, SRE, Customer Success, and Principal Engineers to deliver highly available infrastructure that enables developers worldwide to build software faster, more securely, and at massive scale.

This role is ideal for leaders who enjoy solving complex distributed systems challenges, growing high-performing engineering teams, and remaining deeply engaged in technical architecture and execution.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Harness Cloud platform forms the foundation for Continuous Delivery (CD) and several other Harness products. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team responsible for scaling and evolving the cloud infrastructure that powers our global software delivery platform.

You will:

* Lead a team building the Harness Cloud platform, including lifecycle management of a large fleet of virtual machines, bare-metal infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments.
* Drive the architecture, scalability, security, and reliability of distributed cloud infrastructure powering millions of CI workloads.
* Partner with Product Management to define technical roadmaps and deliver capabilities that improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.
* Work closely with Principal Engineers to define long-term technical strategy and architecture for the Harness Cloud platform.
* Collaborate with Cloud Engineering, SRE, and Customer Success teams to diagnose and resolve complex production issues across distributed infrastructure.
* Foster engineering excellence through architecture reviews, design discussions, peer code reviews, and operational best practices.
* Lead incident response, postmortems, and continuous improvements in observability, resiliency, and operational maturity.
* Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and technical leaders while building an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
* Balance execution of customer commitments with long-term investments in platform scalability, automation, and developer productivity.

**About You**
-------------

### **Proven Engineering Leader**

* 3+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams delivering distributed infrastructure or cloud platform services.
* Proven track record of mentoring engineers while driving technical execution and organizational growth.

### **Distributed Systems**

Strong understanding of:

* Distributed systems
* Virtual Machine lifecycle management
* Container technologies
* Networking
* Storage systems
* Kubernetes
* High availability and fault tolerance

### **Technical Leadership**

* Proven ability to build highly scalable saas services
* Experience authoring architecture documents and technical specifications.
* Ability to break down complex technical problems into executable engineering plans.
* Comfortable driving technical decisions across multiple engineering teams.

### **Operational Excellence**

Experience with:

* Production operations
* Incident management
* Observability
* Monitoring
* Logging
* Performance optimization
* Capacity planning
* Reliability engineering

### **Customer Focus**

* Passionate about building infrastructure that improves developer productivity.
* Comfortable partnering with customer-facing teams to diagnose production issues and influence product direction.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Senior Data Architect
