title: Engineering Manager
description:
#### **About us**

Camascope India is part of Person Centred Software (PCS) Group, a fast-growing technology group focused on empowering the care and medication sector. Following PCS's acquisition of Camascope, our India team continues to build the products that connect pharmacies, care homes and doctors, now as part of a larger, international engineering organisation serving thousands of care professionals every day. This role is dedicated to Camascope eMAR, working closely with our UK product engineering teams.

#### **What you will work on**

As Engineering Manager, you will lead an existing team of engineers in India delivering Camascope eMAR, working closely with a counterpart engineering team in the UK. This is a hands-on role: you will contribute directly to system design and the delivery of features, whether that means writing code, shaping architecture or unblocking the team on complex problems, while also mentoring engineers, raising engineering standards and strengthening delivery practices.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow an existing engineering team in India, developing its capability through mentoring, coaching and career development
* Teach and embed engineering best practices across the team, including code quality, testing, code review, design and delivery habits
* Remain hands-on throughout, contributing directly to system design and the delivery of features alongside the team
* Own day-to-day team operations: sprint delivery, 1:1s, performance management and career development
* Work closely with the UK product engineering team to align on delivery scope, priorities and technical direction for the shared product
* Champion continuous delivery, with testing and security embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and promote DevSecOps practices across the team
* Make significant contributions to technical and architectural decisions, keeping systems, standards and practices coherent with the wider PCS engineering organisation
* Identify and remove blockers, process inefficiencies and technical debt proactively
* Be accountable for the full software development lifecycle, from design through to production, monitoring and support
* Foster a learning and mentoring culture, helping engineers grow in both technical depth and ownership
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA and Design to achieve shared product outcomes.

#### **Requirements**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience as an Engineering Manager or senior technical lead of a team, with a strong portfolio of C#/.NET applications
* Deep understanding of the C#/.NET ecosystem, including building and maintaining .NET backend services, and experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) and cloud-native development
* Experience with modern DevOps/CI-CD practices
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design, security (e.g. OWASP API Security) and system architecture at scale
* Proven experience leading, mentoring and upskilling an engineering team, and establishing or improving delivery practices and engineering standards
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across distributed or international teams
* Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and coaching a team on them
* Good understanding of database technologies, message queues, and data security
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a fix-forward, learning mindset
* Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience working with, or managing engineers who use, AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

#### **Bonus points**

* Hands-on experience with React (web) and/or Flutter (mobile)
* Experience taking over and developing an existing team, or scaling an engineering organisation
* Prior experience in healthcare, care or pharmacy technology, or another highly regulated environment
* Experience with cloud migration projects or multi-cloud environments
* Prior experience in a post-acquisition or newly integrated engineering organisation.

title: Mainframe zOS Administration Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-class z/OS storage solutions to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Lead the architecture and governance of DFSMS and SMS environments, including Storage Groups, Data Classes, Storage Classes, Management Classes, and ACS routines.
* Manage DASD capacity planning, storage optimization, hardware upgrades, and long-term growth strategies.
* Administer and support VTOC, VTOCIX, catalogs, DFSMShsm, and DFSMSdss, ensuring efficient data lifecycle management and recoverability.
* Monitor storage performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive root cause resolution for critical incidents.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities across the storage environment.
* Collaborate with security teams to maintain compliance with audit, regulatory, and access control requirements.
* Lead strategic initiatives including storage modernization, hardware refreshes, data center migrations, z/OS upgrades, cloud integration, automation, and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, JCL, ISPF, and vendor tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for storage-related issues, providing expert guidance and operational leadership.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams to deliver storage services that align with business objectives.
Mentor junior engineers and system programmers, promote knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of standards, procedures, and best practices.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 10+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior OpenSearch Engineer
description:

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior OpenSearch Engineer to design, build, and  
optimize next-generation search platforms for a large-scale eCommerce ecosystem.  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Vector  
Search, Semantic Retrieval, Generative AI, Amazon Bedrock, and Retrieval  
Augmented Generation (RAG). This role will focus on enhancing product discovery, search  
relevance, recommendations, conversational commerce, and AI-powered customer  
experiences.  
The engineer will partner with Product, Data Science, Merchandising, and Engineering  
teams to deliver scalable search architectures that combine traditional keyword-based  
retrieval with modern semantic and GenAI-powered search capabilities.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Search Platform Engineering**  

* Design, deploy, and manage enterprise-scale OpenSearch clusters.
* **Build high-performance search solutions for:**

o Product Discovery  
o Category Navigation  
o Filtering & Faceted Search  
o Autocomplete & Suggestions  
o Product Recommendations  

* **Configure and maintain:**

o Index Mappings  
o Analyzers  
o Tokenizers  
o Synonym Dictionaries  
o Ranking Models  

* Optimize search relevance, latency, aggregations, and query performance.
* Build real-time and near-real-time indexing pipelines

**Vector Search & Semantic Retrieval**  

* Design and implement vector-based retrieval systems.
* Develop semantic search capabilities using embedding models.
* Implement and optimize:

o Dense Vector Indexing  
o k-NN Search  
o Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN)  
o Similarity Search  
o Hybrid Search (Keyword + Vector)

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Plotline**
------------------

Plotline is a 1:1 personalisation platform helping brands treat every user like the only user, turning generic, one-size-fits-all apps into experiences that feel personally made.  
  
Product and growth teams at Meesho, SBI, Dream11, CoinDCX, BharatPe and Upstox use Plotline to move the metrics that matter. Behind the scenes, we power over 5 billion API calls a month and reach more than 150 million users and are growing fast internationally.

We're fast-moving, well-funded, obsessed with craft and allergic to the generic.

**The Role**

Plotline is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the automated systems that generate and convert pipeline for the India revenue team. You will turn manual sales work into scalable workflows, so reps spend their time on conversations and deals.

**1. Build the Pipeline Engine**
--------------------------------

* Build outbound workflows: prospecting, enrichment waterfalls, scoring and sequencing.
* Automate lead routing, handoffs and follow-ups between BDRs, AEs and marketing.
* Prototype AI-assisted research and personalization, then test and tune what works.

**2. Own the GTM Stack**
------------------------

* Own CRM architecture, integrations and automations across enrichment, sequencing and billing tools.
* Keep data clean with validation, dedupe and enrichment rules.
* Evaluate and implement new tools, APIs and data sources.

**3. Measure and Enable Sales**
-------------------------------

* Build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, cost per meeting and forecast accuracy.
* Run experiments on messaging, channels and ICP segments, and report what moves the pipeline.
* Support enterprise deal needs, such as account research, security review tracking and contract workflows.

**Must Have**
-------------

* 3 to 5 years in GTM engineering, RevOps, sales ops or growth engineering at a B2B SaaS company
* Hands-on with a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) and automation tools (Clay, Zapier, Make or n8n)
* Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and SQL; scripting in Python or JavaScript is a plus
* Experience with sequencing and data enrichment tools

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Early-stage startup experience (seed to Series B)
* Experience building AI or LLM-based sales workflows
* Exposure to enterprise sales cycles
* Multi-region setup (US, SEA, MENA) and multi-currency billing

**Outcomes Expected**
---------------------

* **First 90 days:** audit the funnel and stack, fix CRM data, and ship the first automated outbound and routing workflows.
* **6 months:** enrichment, scoring and sequencing running as a measured system, with clear pipeline and cost-per-meeting tracking.
* **12 months:** a scalable India pipeline engine, with workflows ready to replicate in SEA and MENA.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**

Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.

**Who You Are:**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do:**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

title: Mainframe Storage System administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and support enterprise-wide **z/OS storage solutions** , ensuring scalability, availability, and performance.
* Administer and govern **DFSMS/SMS environments** , including ACS routines, Storage Groups, Storage Classes, Data Classes, and Management Classes.
* Manage and optimize **DASD storage infrastructure** , monitor utilization trends, perform capacity planning, and support storage growth initiatives.
* Maintain **VTOC, VTOCIX, and catalog environments** , resolving allocation, extent, connectivity, and catalog-related issues.
* Administer **DFSMShsm and DFSMSdss** services, supporting backup, migration, archiving, disaster recovery, and recovery operations.
* Monitor storage subsystem performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and drive continuous service improvements.
* Ensure storage environments meet **security, audit, and compliance** requirements through effective access controls and governance practices.
* Lead storage-related projects including hardware refreshes, storage modernization, data center migrations, z/OS upgrades, cloud integration, and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using **REXX, JCL, ISPF, and vendor tools** to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as the highest level technical escalation point for complex storage incidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support business-critical initiatives and operational excellence.
Mentor junior engineers, create technical documentation, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the storage organization.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 8+ Years of Experience in Mainframe Storage Administration.
* Experience with DASD and tape data storage solutions (Experience on DASD/Tape Configuration and Migration) for mainframes.
* Candidate should possess working knowledge of Z/OS Operating System, z/OS(MVS) fundamentals, Storage fundamentals and Storage Devices.
* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge in the following areas: TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, ISMF, JES2, Catalogs, Datasets (PS/PDS/PDSE/GDG), REXX, SAS, SDSF and Spool.
* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge & Experience in the following (: MF - Tape & DASD Management) areas: DFSMS, DFSMSHSM, DFSMSDSS, DFSMSDFP, DFSMSRMM, ICF Catalog, VSAM, IDCAMs, CA products (CA Disk, CA allocate and CA-1), FDR products, Omegamon XE or related Storage monitoring tools, ICKDSF, Space abends and SMF/Dcollect/BVIR reports.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* Provides technical support activities for a production mainframe environment of multiple LPARs, CECs, DASD and VTS controllers.
* Experience in Storage box data migration (DASD to DASD and Tape to tape) and Storage replication.
* Candidates have to work in customer work hours- US, Europe and Asia Pacific (weekends and holidays as on call staff).

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end — from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface — and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications — not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own features end to end — database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface — operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker.
* Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next.js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services.
* Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces..
* Build and productionize AI-agentified features — agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling — grounded in 1–2 years of hands-on experience with these systems.
* Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.
* Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.
* Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning.
* Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend.
* Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.
* Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

***Education & Experience***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).
* 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production..
* Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery.

***Technical Skills — Applied AI***

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs.
* Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

***Technical Skills — Full Stack***

* Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR).
* Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs.
* Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.

***Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability***

* Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling.
* Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks.
* Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity.

***Soft Skills***

* Proactive communication — shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early.
* Asks the right questions — clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation.
* Ownership mindset — treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets.
* Transparency — speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions.
* Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects — production deployment experience preferred.
* Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices.
* Testing experience across unit and integration levels.
* Experience with modern web app tooling — component libraries (e.g., Tailwind, MUI) and state management (e.g., Redux, Zustand).
* Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

We are seeking a 12+ experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, SQL Data Warehouse, and modern cloud data platforms to define and implement scalable, secure, high-performance data architectures.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into robust enterprise data architecture and solution designs, defining data platforms, integration patterns, data models, governance frameworks, and analytics solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, BI teams, application teams, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver scalable and cost-effective data solutions.

The Data Architect will provide technical leadership across batch and real-time data processing, Lakehouse/Data Warehouse architecture, data integration, data modeling, data governance, security, Power BI, and cloud data platforms**.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Architecture & Solution Design**

* Good exposure to work on RFP’s, sales proposal, technical and estimate.

**Microsoft Fabric & Databricks Architecture**

* Define enterprise architecture using Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows, Power BI, and related Fabric capabilities.
* Design scalable Azure Databricks and Delta Lake architectures for large-scale data processing and analytics.
* Define Bronze, Silver, and Gold data-layer strategies and standards.
* Design Databricks solutions using Apache Spark, Structured Streaming, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and optimized data processing patterns.
* Define standards for partitioning, file sizes, schema evolution, incremental processing, data retention, and performance optimization.
* Guide teams in optimizing Databricks workloads for performance and cloud cost efficiency.

**Data Integration & ETL/ELT Architecture**

* Design data integration architectures for data originating from databases, APIs, files, SaaS applications, Dynamics 365, and streaming sources.

* Define frameworks for incremental loads, CDC, SCD Type 1/Type 2, reconciliation, error handling, and data recovery.

* Define enterprise data standards, naming conventions, data domains, and master/reference data structures.
* Design models optimized for Power BI, analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.
* Define strategies for managing historical data, slowly changing dimensions, data retention, and archival.

* Define enterprise data governance and security architecture across the data platform.
* Implement and govern Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, RBAC, data classification, lineage, auditing, and access-control strategies.
* Define security patterns for row-level security, column-level security, masking, encryption, secrets management, and secure data access.
* Establish data ownership, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and data quality standards.

title: AI Factory Architecture Lead
description:

**This position reports to:**

Operational Excellence Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**

  

* Energy Industries is establishing an AI Factory as the AI Transformation Engine for the division. The AI Factory enables, accelerates and scales AI transformation across functions by providing governance, expertise, delivery capabilities, reusable assets and capability development.
* As AI Factory Architecture Lead, you will serve as the divisional AI Technical Authority within the AI Factory, leading and orchestrating architecture activities across the AI Factory ecosystem.
* You will be accountable for ensuring that the right architecture is developed, reviewed and approved to deliver scalable, sustainable, secure and future-ready AI capabilities. You will set technical direction, prioritize and coordinate architecture activities across delivery teams, and ensure that the appropriate competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs.
* This is a technical leadership and design authority role. You will lead the architecture capability and enable architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to create coherent, reusable and future-ready solutions.

**Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide***\**

While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience are matching this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.

This position does **not require relocation**. The successful candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and orchestrate AI architecture across the AI Factory portfolio, setting technical direction, priorities and sequencing of architecture work.
* Provide technical and design authority, reviewing and approving AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* Ensure the right architecture competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs, working with delivery teams and AI Factory Operations to address gaps.
* Drive common architecture, standards and reuse, ensuring that reference architectures, reusable patterns and technical guardrails are developed, maintained and adopted.
* Lead the AI architecture community, connecting architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to share knowledge, challenge approaches and shape technical direction.
* Anticipate the rapid evolution of AI, leading assessment of emerging technologies and ensuring the technology roadmap remains relevant and avoids unnecessary technical debt or early obsolescence.
* Lead technical alignment with Functions, IS, Data organizations, delivery teams and external technology partners, including technical evaluation of delivery approaches and vendors.
* Resolve and govern key architecture decisions, balancing innovation, speed, security, sustainability and long-term maintainability, and escalating significant cross-domain decisions through AI Factory governance where required.

*Our team dynamics*

* You will lead and orchestrate the AI architecture capability across Energy Industries, coordinating architects and technical experts embedded across multiple delivery teams and organizations.
* You will be accountable for technical direction, prioritization of architecture work, appropriate architecture competence and capacity, and approval of AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* The role leads primarily through technical authority, functional leadership and influence rather than direct line management. The approved role already positions this function as the principal AI technical authority influencing architects, engineers, delivery teams and external partners.

**Qualifications for the role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* At least 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, solution design or technology leadership.
* Strong technical background with the credibility to lead senior architects and technical specialists.
* Experience leading architecture or technical work across multiple teams and complex initiatives.
* Experience delivering AI, analytics, machine learning or digital platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of the AI technology ecosystem and emerging trends.
* Ability to translate business priorities into technical direction and make sound decisions balancing speed, quality, reuse and sustainability.
* Strong stakeholder leadership and communication skills.

**Preferred background**

* + Experience in industrial digitalization or engineering-led environments.
  + Experience in technical authority, lead engineering, architecture leadership or comparable functional leadership roles.
  + Experience in consulting, scale-up or high-growth technology environments.
  + Experience leading technical communities and working across internal and external delivery organizations.

**Your application will get our interest if you**

* + Are a technical leader and orchestrator with the depth and credibility to challenge experienced architects and make sound technical decisions.
  + Enjoy enabling talented specialists and creating clarity when priorities compete for limited capacity.
  + Bring a builder mentality, technical curiosity and a practical approach to execution.
  + Are comfortable making decisions in a rapidly changing technology landscape.
  + Influence effectively across organizational boundaries and challenge established thinking constructively.
  + Balance innovation with reuse, maintainability and minimizing technical debt.

* *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. title: Senior Researcher - Self-Evolving Agentic Systems
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Research India is a leading research lab advancing innovation across areas including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Theory, Technology and Empowerment, and Systems. Established two decades ago, the lab has been at the forefront of computer science research in India and is home to researchers and impactful projects.

AI agents are moving beyond fixed prompts and static policies. They can now plan, use tools, write code, and work across long, multi-step tasks. However, most agents still cannot continuously improve through their own experience, learn from failures, or adapt while operating.

Our team is building **self-evolving agentic systems**: agents that improve their own policies, skills, memory, and scaffolding through interaction, feedback, and reinforcement learning.

 **Responsibilities**

As a **Senior Researcher – Self-Evolving Agentic Systems**, you will advance the state of the art in how LLM-based agents learn and adapt. You will work across the full stack, from designing reinforcement learning algorithms and reward signals to building environments and evaluations and translating research ideas into systems that operate at scale.

You will collaborate with researchers and engineers across Microsoft Research India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to contribute to both the research community and products used by millions of people.

### **We are looking for candidates who:**

* Are passionate about advancing the state of the art in reinforcement learning, LLM post-training, and autonomous agents.
* Have a strong research track record demonstrated through publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM, or similar venues, or through impactful open-source contributions.
* Combine scientific rigor with strong engineering skills and enjoy turning research ideas into working systems.
* Thrive in a highly collaborative research environment.
* Take end-to-end ownership of complex, open-ended research problems.

  
**Qualifications**  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead research on self-evolving agents, including self-improvement loops, experience-driven learning, self-generated curricula, and automatic refinement of agent policies, tools, and memory.
* Design and apply reinforcement learning methods for LLM-based agents, including reward modeling, learning from verifiable and AI feedback, and credit assignment over long, multi-step tasks.
* Build scalable training and evaluation environments for agentic tasks such as coding, tool use, web and computer use, and knowledge work.
* Develop rigorous benchmarks and evaluation methods that measure agent capability, robustness, safety, and improvement over time.
* Form hypotheses, design experiments, and iterate quickly on model and agent performance.
* Publish at top-tier venues, release open-source artifacts, and help shape the research agenda in agentic AI.
* Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to move research advances into real-world systems.
* **Mentor interns and early-career researchers** and contribute to Microsoft Research India’s academic engagement.
* Embody our culture and values.

### **Required Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 1+ years of software engineering or research experience.
* Experience with reinforcement learning and LLMs.
* Strong research track record in machine learning, computer systems, or a closely related area.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, or other impactful outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building and scaling large AI systems.
* Experience applying reinforcement learning to AI models and agents.
* Experience with reward modeling, reinforcement learning, or other post-training techniques.
* Hands-on experience building datasets for LLM, VLM, or multimodal model pre-training or post-training.
* Experience with synthetic data, model graders, reward signals, hard-example mining, active learning, or data-mixture optimization.
* Experience building feedback loops that connect evaluation, failure mining, data generation, and training.
* Experience with multimodal or agentic datasets, including text, web, GUI, tool-use, or interaction trajectories.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Please apply using the application link above. In addition, please send an email to the Hiring Committee at **seas-hiring-msri@microsoft.com**.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Senior Staff, Emulation Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

The Connectivity Business Unit at Marvell is at the forefront of delivering high-performance silicon for the world's most demanding data infrastructure, spanning Optical DSPs, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices. Within the BU, the Pre-Silicon Emulation team plays a critical role in program execution—bridging RTL design and real-world system behavior before a single chip is taped out. Our team owns emulation model development, test execution, and system-level debug across Marvell's emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), enabling early firmware bring-up, hardware/software co-validation, and risk reduction on the path to silicon. We work closely with design, verification, firmware, software, and post-silicon teams to ensure emulation is a productive, schedule-driving resource—not a bottleneck. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems at the intersection of hardware and software, and want your work to directly impact the success of next-generation connectivity silicon, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect**

Execute emulation model bring-up, test development, and debug for connectivity silicon programs, including ODSP, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices, on platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, and Zebu.

Work with design, validation, and firmware teams to understand emulation hardware and software requirements, and implement platform configurations, transactors, speed bridges, protocol adapters, and firmware/software stacks.

Engage with EDA and emulation hardware vendors to resolve platform, tooling, and model issues and maintain a productive emulation environment.

Develop and maintain HW/SW enablement flows and scripts to support RTL validation and improve emulation model usability for firmware, driver, and system software development.

Collaborate with pre-silicon validation, design, firmware, and post-silicon teams to identify and resolve emulation bottlenecks and improve validation coverage.

Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure to improve emulation environment productivity, reliability, and utilization within assigned programs.

**What We're Looking For**

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's/PhD with 3+ years of experience.

Hands-on experience with one or more SoC emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), including building and maintaining emulation models for SoC designs.

Background in test planning, simulation, and debug in Verilog/SystemVerilog environments.

Experience with SoC development flows, emulation-based debug, and system-level validation.

Scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, and/or UNIX shell.

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including design, validation, firmware, and vendor partners.

Good to Have

Experience with emulation of networking devices or mixed-signal designs, including systems containing PHY or Layer-2/Layer-3 functionality.

Exposure to connectivity-focused silicon, such as:

Optical DSPs (ODSP)

High-speed Ethernet PHYs

AEC/AOC enablement devices

Familiarity with firmware or software bring-up using emulation platforms.

Experience contributing to or improving emulation infrastructure within a project or product line.

  
This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

**Preferred skills and experience**

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. ### **What you’ll be doing…**

As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What we’re looking for...**

You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.

**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior SRAM Circuit Design Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

The Digital IP (DIP) group at NVIDIA is an organization of circuit design and CAD engineers that creates a wide variety of IP for the chips NVIDIA designs. This group works closely with internal SOC design, silicon testing, and productization teams that turn our IP into products that change the world. One of the roles fulfilled by the DIP group is to develop sophisticated SRAM compilers that are used extensively by our SOC design partners. We are looking to hire a skilled and creative SRAM circuit designer to help achieve these goals in a high-visibility position.

**What you'll be doing:**

title: Principal I, Research & Development Process & Product Design (T)
description:
**Summary of Position:**

Alcon is hiring a Principal Engineer I to join our Surgical R&D organization. This role will convert complex industrial design concepts, SolidWorks models, and visual renderings into robust Creo Parametric master models that define the aesthetic exterior surfaces and packaging architecture of medical consoles, carts, and handpieces. The engineer will bridge industrial design intent and production-ready mechanical design, ensuring exterior skins, interfaces, and supporting components can be manufactured, assembled, controlled, and revised throughout product development.

The ideal candidate combines advanced Creo surfacing and top-down design expertise with practical DFM experience for injection-molded plastics and cast components. The position will work closely with industrial design, mechanical engineering, human factors, manufacturing, suppliers, and quality partners to preserve the intended appearance while meeting functional, dimensional, manufacturing, and medical-device development requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Convert industrial design concepts from SolidWorks files, surface data, sketches, and renderings into controlled Creo Parametric geometry and production-intent master models.
* Create and maintain aesthetic exterior skins for medical consoles, equipment carts, handpieces, and related surgical-system components.
* Develop high-quality complex surfaces, transitions, parting strategies, shutoffs, interfaces, and split lines while preserving industrial design intent.
* Establish and sustain top-down skeleton architecture, master-model methodology, published geometry, and interface control across modules and assemblies.
* Derive production components and assemblies from the master model, including plastic housings, bezels, covers, handles, cast structures, and supporting mechanical parts.
* Assess imported SolidWorks geometry for quality, continuity, manufacturability, and design intent; rebuild or optimize geometry in Creo when required for stable parametric control.
* Partner with industrial designers to translate visual intent into measurable geometry, resolve design feasibility issues, and manage appearance-impacting changes.
* Apply DFM/DFA principles for injection-molded plastics and cast components, including draft, wall thickness, ribs, bosses, tooling access, parting lines, sink-risk reduction, and assembly interfaces.
* Perform fit, form, interface, clearance, and tolerance assessments to verify that exterior components integrate with internal structures, displays, controls, connectors, service features, and adjacent modules.
* Create detailed models and drawings with appropriate GD&T, datum strategies, and tolerance analysis for supplier quotation, fabrication, inspection, and release.
* Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing teams to review tooling concepts, molding or casting feasibility, cosmetic requirements, secondary operations, and design changes.
* Use Windchill for product-data management, revision control, configuration management, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Lead design reviews and provide technical direction on Creo surfacing, master modeling, top-down design, model robustness, and configuration control.
* Mentor engineers and designers in Creo Parametric, complex surfacing, geometry translation, and master-model best practices.
* Improve and standardize CAD methods, design practices, checklists, and reusable approaches for industrial-design-to-engineering handoff.

**Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering**, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent directly related experience.

**Principal Engineer - Creo Industrial Design and Master Modeling**

* **10 or more years of relevant product design and mechanical engineering experience.**
* **Advanced proficiency in Creo Parametric, including complex surfacing, top-down design, skeletons, master models, published geometry, and robust parametric modeling.**
* **Demonstrated experience converting industrial design concepts or non-native CAD data into production-ready Creo master models.**
* Strong experience designing aesthetic exterior components for complex electromechanical products.
* **Practical DFM/DFA experience for injection-molded plastic and cast components, including collaboration with tooling and manufacturing suppliers.**
* Working knowledge of GD&T, datum schemes, tolerance analysis, engineering drawings, and dimensional control.
* Experience managing CAD data, revisions, and product structures in Windchill or a comparable PLM system.
* Ability to communicate design tradeoffs clearly and collaborate across industrial design, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced R&D environment and provide technical leadership with limited supervision.
* The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Creo ISDX or other advanced Creo surfacing tools used to create and control complex exterior geometry.
* Proficiency reviewing or working with SolidWorks part, assembly, and surface models.
* Experience applying Model-Based Definition (MBD) practices, including creation and downstream use of 3D product definition and semantic PMI.
* Experience using Creo GD&T Advisor to define and validate GD&T and semantic product manufacturing information.
* Experience using CeTol 6 Sigma for tolerance stack-up analysis and design optimization.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to support engineering workflows, such as concept development, design analysis, documentation, knowledge capture, or process improvement.
* Experience with medical devices, surgical systems, capital equipment, handheld instruments, or other regulated electromechanical products.
* Experience developing cosmetic plastic housings and exterior components where surface quality, gaps, flushness, texture, color, and visible interfaces are important.
* Knowledge of plastic resin selection, casting alloys, tooling limitations, tolerance capability, and supplier manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting concept development through prototype, verification, tooling, design transfer, and production release.

title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
description:

**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.

* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See:**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd** :

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters
